-- d11_ptrunk (2026-11-16): correcao do motor da D12. O balanco de assentamento marca o objeto como assentado logo
-- depois do impacto; dai ele dormia com a rotacao zerada e a estabilidade desistia (settled), e um objeto que comecava a
-- tombar congelava no meio (garrafa parada a -36 graus) ou dormia torto perto da face (-80). Regra: so dorme encaixado
-- numa face (pitch e roll a ate stableOrientationSnapDegrees, o encaixe final do proprio motor, de um multiplo de 90),
-- ou com a pose travada pelo propbrowser (stabilityMode 'lock'). Fora disso a estabilidade gira ate encaixar.
local function restingOnFace(rec, cfg)
    if rec.stabilityMode == 'lock' then return true end
    local tol = (tonumber(cfg and cfg.stableOrientationSnapDegrees) or 2.4) + 0.5
    local function off(a)
        a = normalizeAngle180(tonumber(a) or 0.0)
        return math.abs(normalizeAngle180(a - math.floor((a + 45.0) / 90.0) * 90.0))
    end
    return off(rec.pitch) <= tol and off(rec.roll) <= tol
end

PT.StepVisualPropPhysics = function(force)
    if not PT.VisualPhysicsEnabled() or not State.active or not State.vehicle or not DoesEntityExist(State.vehicle) then return end
    local props = PT.GetVisualProps and PT.GetVisualProps() or {}
    if not props or #props == 0 then return end

    local cfg = Config.VisualPropPhysics or {}
    local nowMs = GetGameTimer()
    local propCount = #props
    local stepMs = tonumber(cfg.stepMs) or 16
    if propCount >= 24 then
        stepMs = math.max(stepMs, tonumber(cfg.largeInventoryStepMs) or 45)
    elseif propCount >= 14 then
        stepMs = math.max(stepMs, tonumber(cfg.mediumInventoryStepMs) or 30)
    end
    if not force and (nowMs - (PT.VisualPhysicsState.lastStepAt or 0)) < stepMs then return end

    if not force then
        local hasActivePhysics = false
        for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
            local key = prop and PT.GetVisualPhysicsKey and PT.GetVisualPhysicsKey(prop) or nil
            if key
                and (PT.VisualPhysicsState.settled[key] ~= true
                    or (PT.VisualPhysicsState.dirty and PT.VisualPhysicsState.dirty[key] ~= nil)
                    or (PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved and PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved(prop))
                    or (PT.IsVisualPropBeingManipulated and PT.IsVisualPropBeingManipulated(prop))) then
                hasActivePhysics = true
                break
            elseif not key then
                hasActivePhysics = true
                break
            end
        end
        if not hasActivePhysics then
            local sleepStepMs = tonumber(cfg.sleepingInventoryStepMs) or 360
            if (nowMs - (PT.VisualPhysicsState.lastSleepingStepAt or 0)) < sleepStepMs then
                PT.VisualPhysicsState.lastStepAt = nowMs
                return
            end
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.lastSleepingStepAt = nowMs
        end
    end
    PT.VisualPhysicsState.lastStepAt = nowMs

    local pctx = buildVehiclePlacementContext(State.vehicle)
    local floorZ = getPivotBaseZForCurrentVehicle() + (tonumber(cfg.groundPadding) or 0.006)
    local gravity = tonumber(cfg.gravity) or 0.010
    local maxFallVelocity = math.abs(tonumber(cfg.maxFallVelocity) or 0.035)
    local damping = tonumber(cfg.verticalDamping) or 0.42
    local angularDamping = tonumber(cfg.angularDamping) or 0.65
    local impactAngularDamping = tonumber(cfg.impactAngularDamping) or 0.86
    local fallAngularTorque = tonumber(cfg.fallAngularTorque) or 0.0
    local floorFrictionAngularDamping = tonumber(cfg.floorFrictionAngularDamping) or 0.5
    local impactTorque = tonumber(cfg.impactTorque) or 2.8
    local minImpactVelocity = tonumber(cfg.minImpactVelocity) or 0.006
    local yawImpulse = tonumber(cfg.collisionYawImpulse) or 2.2
    local pitchImpulse = tonumber(cfg.collisionPitchImpulse) or 1.1
    local rollImpulse = tonumber(cfg.collisionRollImpulse) or 1.1
    local rotationSettle = tonumber(cfg.rotationSettle) or tonumber(cfg.floorPitchSettle) or 0.18
    local safeGap = tonumber(cfg.safeGap) or 0.014
    local stackSupportPadding = tonumber(cfg.stackSupportPadding) or 0.040
    local stackOriginTopMargin = tonumber(cfg.stackOriginTopMargin) or 0.018
    local stackVerticalReach = tonumber(cfg.stackVerticalReach) or 0.120
    local stackDropVerticalReach = tonumber(cfg.stackDropVerticalReach) or math.max(stackVerticalReach, 0.180)
    local settledSleepZTolerance = tonumber(cfg.settledSleepZTolerance) or 0.006
    PT.VisualPhysicsState.stackSupports = PT.VisualPhysicsState.stackSupports or {}
    local records = {}

    for _, prop in ipairs(props) do
        local rec = PT.BuildVisualPhysicsRecord(prop, pctx, floorZ, cfg)
        if rec then
            records[#records + 1] = rec
        end
    end

    for _, rec in ipairs(records) do
        if rec.movable then
            local velocity = tonumber(PT.VisualPhysicsState.velocities[rec.key]) or 0.0
            local angular = PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[rec.key] or { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, roll = 0.0 }
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[rec.key] = angular
            local recFloorZ = tonumber(rec.floorZ) or floorZ
            local previousSupportKey = PT.VisualPhysicsState.stackSupports[rec.key]
            local activeSupportKey = nil
            local recPlayerMoved = PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved(rec.prop)
            for _, support in ipairs(records) do
                if support ~= rec then
                    local supportTop = (tonumber(support.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(support.topRelZ) or 0.0)
                    local recBottom = (tonumber(rec.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(rec.bottomRelZ) or 0.0)
                    -- Only use this support if rec is actually above it (box bottom above support top - margin),
                    -- the support top is reachable from below, and footprints overlap.
                    local recIsAbove = recBottom >= (supportTop - stackOriginTopMargin)
                    local supportReachable = supportTop <= recBottom + stackVerticalReach
                    local dropReachable = supportTop <= recBottom + stackDropVerticalReach
                    local supportUnavailable = PT.IsVisualPropSupportDisabled(support.prop) or PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved(support.prop)
                    local supportOverlaps = false
                    local supportReachRadius = (((tonumber(rec.radius) or 0.0) + (tonumber(support.radius) or 0.0)) * 2.35) + stackSupportPadding + 0.055
                    local supportDx = (tonumber(support.x) or 0.0) - (tonumber(rec.x) or 0.0)
                    local supportDy = (tonumber(support.y) or 0.0) - (tonumber(rec.y) or 0.0)
                    if ((supportDx * supportDx) + (supportDy * supportDy)) <= (supportReachRadius * supportReachRadius) then
                        supportOverlaps = PT.FootprintsOverlapRelaxed(rec, support, stackSupportPadding)
                    end
                    local recBottomNearSupport = recBottom >= (supportTop - stackOriginTopMargin)
                        and recBottom <= (supportTop + stackVerticalReach)
                    local placeMovedItemOnStaticSupport = recPlayerMoved
                        and not supportUnavailable
                        and dropReachable
                        and supportOverlaps
                    local keepMovedBaseSupport = supportUnavailable
                        and previousSupportKey ~= nil
                        and previousSupportKey == support.key
                        and recIsAbove
                        and recBottomNearSupport
                        and supportOverlaps
                    local canUseSupport = ((not supportUnavailable and recIsAbove and supportReachable)
                        or placeMovedItemOnStaticSupport
                        or keepMovedBaseSupport)
                    if canUseSupport and supportOverlaps then
                        -- stackTopPad do SUPORTE: eleva o item empilhado pela folga entre
                        -- a malha visual e o physics bounds do prop de baixo (sem inflar o
                        -- extent usado no portao recIsAbove acima).
                        local supportPad = tonumber(support.stackTopPad) or 0.0
                        local candidateFloor = supportTop - (tonumber(rec.supportBottomRelZ) or tonumber(rec.bottomRelZ) or 0.0) + 0.006 + supportPad
                        if candidateFloor > recFloorZ then
                            recFloorZ = candidateFloor
                            activeSupportKey = support.key
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            if activeSupportKey then
                PT.VisualPhysicsState.stackSupports[rec.key] = activeSupportKey
            elseif recFloorZ <= ((tonumber(rec.floorZ) or floorZ) + 0.001) then
                PT.VisualPhysicsState.stackSupports[rec.key] = nil
            end
            local settledSleeping = PT.VisualPhysicsState.settled[rec.key] == true
                and rec.needsSettleWobble ~= true
                and math.abs((tonumber(rec.z) or recFloorZ) - recFloorZ) <= settledSleepZTolerance
            -- d11_ptrunk: assentado mas fora de uma face = ainda tombando; acorda e a estabilidade continua o giro.
            if settledSleeping and not restingOnFace(rec, cfg) then
                settledSleeping = false
                PT.VisualPhysicsState.settled[rec.key] = nil
                PT.ApplyVisualPropStability(rec, cfg)
            end
            if settledSleeping then
                rec.sleeping = true
                rec.z = recFloorZ
                velocity = 0.0
                angular.yaw = 0.0
                angular.pitch = 0.0
                angular.roll = 0.0
            elseif rec.z > recFloorZ + 0.001 then
                local impactVelocity = velocity - gravity
                velocity = velocity - gravity
                if maxFallVelocity > 0.0 and velocity < -maxFallVelocity then
                    velocity = -maxFallVelocity
                end
                if fallAngularTorque > 0.0 then
                    local yawRad = math.rad((tonumber(rec.yaw) or 0.0) + ((tonumber(rec.x) or 0.0) * 47.0) + ((tonumber(rec.y) or 0.0) * 31.0))
                    local fallEnergy = math.min(1.0, math.abs(velocity) / math.max(gravity * 8.0, 0.001))
                    angular.yaw = (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) + (math.sin(yawRad * 0.67) * fallAngularTorque * 0.38 * fallEnergy)
                    angular.pitch = (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) + (math.sin(yawRad) * fallAngularTorque * fallEnergy)
                    angular.roll = (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) + (math.cos(yawRad * 1.21) * fallAngularTorque * fallEnergy)
                    angular.yaw = (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) * angularDamping
                    angular.pitch = (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) * angularDamping
                    angular.roll = (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) * angularDamping
                end
                rec.z = math.max(recFloorZ, rec.z + velocity)
                if rec.z <= recFloorZ + 0.001 then
                    rec.z = recFloorZ
                    if math.abs(impactVelocity) >= minImpactVelocity then
                        local yawRad = math.rad((tonumber(rec.yaw) or 0.0) + ((tonumber(rec.x) or 0.0) * 41.0) + ((tonumber(rec.y) or 0.0) * 29.0))
                        local impactEnergy = math.min(1.0, math.abs(impactVelocity) / math.max(maxFallVelocity, minImpactVelocity, 0.001))
                        angular.yaw = (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) + (math.sin(yawRad * 0.61) * impactTorque * 0.55 * impactEnergy)
                        angular.pitch = (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) + (math.sin(yawRad) * impactTorque * impactEnergy)
                        angular.roll = (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) + (math.cos(yawRad) * impactTorque * impactEnergy)
                    end
                    PT.ApplyVisualPropSettleWobble(rec, cfg, true)
                    PT.ApplyVisualPropStability(rec, cfg)
                    velocity = math.abs(velocity) * damping
                    if velocity < 0.004 then velocity = 0.0 end
                end
                rec.dirty = true
            elseif rec.z < recFloorZ - 0.001 then
                rec.z = recFloorZ
                velocity = 0.0
                rec.dirty = true
                PT.ApplyVisualPropStability(rec, cfg)
            else
                rec.z = recFloorZ
                velocity = 0.0
                PT.ApplyVisualPropSettleWobble(rec, cfg, false)
                PT.ApplyVisualPropStability(rec, cfg)
                angular.yaw = (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) * floorFrictionAngularDamping
                angular.pitch = (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) * floorFrictionAngularDamping
                angular.roll = (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) * floorFrictionAngularDamping
            end
            if math.abs(tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) > 0.01 or math.abs(tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) > 0.01 or math.abs(tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) > 0.01 then
                rec.yaw = normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.yaw) or 0.0) + (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0))
                rec.pitch = normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.pitch) or 0.0) + (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0))
                rec.roll = normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.roll) or 0.0) + (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0))
                angular.yaw = (tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) * impactAngularDamping
                angular.pitch = (tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) * impactAngularDamping
                angular.roll = (tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) * impactAngularDamping
                if math.abs(tonumber(angular.yaw) or 0.0) < 0.01 then angular.yaw = 0.0 end
                if math.abs(tonumber(angular.pitch) or 0.0) < 0.01 then angular.pitch = 0.0 end
                if math.abs(tonumber(angular.roll) or 0.0) < 0.01 then angular.roll = 0.0 end
                rec.floorZ = PT.GetVisualPropFloorOriginZ(rec.prop, floorZ, rec.pitch, rec.roll, rec.yaw)
                rec.z = math.max(tonumber(rec.floorZ) or recFloorZ, rec.z)
                rec.bottomRelZ, rec.topRelZ = PT.GetVisualPropVerticalExtents(rec.prop, rec.pitch, rec.roll, rec.yaw)
                refreshRecordSupportExtents(rec)
                rec.footprint = PT.GetVisualPropFootprintPoints(rec.prop, rec.x, rec.y, rec.yaw, rec.pitch, rec.roll)
                rec.dirty = true
            end
            if rotationSettle > 0.0 and rec.z <= recFloorZ + 0.001 then
                local pitchDelta = normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.restPitch) or 0.0) - (tonumber(rec.pitch) or 0.0))
                if math.abs(pitchDelta) > 0.05 then
                    rec.pitch = normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.pitch) or 0.0) + (pitchDelta * rotationSettle))
                    if math.abs(normalizeAngle180((tonumber(rec.restPitch) or 0.0) - rec.pitch)) < 0.08 then
                        rec.pitch = normalizeAngle180(tonumber(rec.restPitch) or rec.pitch)
                    end
                    rec.floorZ = PT.GetVisualPropFloorOriginZ(rec.prop, floorZ, rec.pitch, rec.roll, rec.yaw)
                    rec.z = math.max(tonumber(rec.floorZ) or recFloorZ, rec.z)
                    rec.bottomRelZ, rec.topRelZ = PT.GetVisualPropVerticalExtents(rec.prop, rec.pitch, rec.roll, rec.yaw)
                    refreshRecordSupportExtents(rec)
                    rec.footprint = PT.GetVisualPropFootprintPoints(rec.prop, rec.x, rec.y, rec.yaw, rec.pitch, rec.roll)
                    rec.dirty = true
                end
            end
            rec.footprint = PT.GetVisualPropFootprintPoints(rec.prop, rec.x, rec.y, rec.yaw, rec.pitch, rec.roll)
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.velocities[rec.key] = velocity
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[rec.key] = angular
        else
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.velocities[rec.key] = 0.0
            PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[rec.key] = { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, roll = 0.0 }
        end
    end

    local iterations = math.max(1, math.min(8, tonumber(cfg.collisionIterations) or 4))
    if propCount >= 24 then
        iterations = math.min(iterations, tonumber(cfg.largeInventoryCollisionIterations) or 2)
    elseif propCount >= 14 then
        iterations = math.min(iterations, tonumber(cfg.mediumInventoryCollisionIterations) or 3)
    end
    for _ = 1, iterations do
        for i = 1, #records - 1 do
            local a = records[i]
            for j = i + 1, #records do
                local b = records[j]
                local aMinZ = (tonumber(a.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(a.supportBottomRelZ) or tonumber(a.bottomRelZ) or 0.0)
                local aMaxZ = (tonumber(a.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(a.supportTopRelZ) or tonumber(a.topRelZ) or 0.0)
                local bMinZ = (tonumber(b.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(b.supportBottomRelZ) or tonumber(b.bottomRelZ) or 0.0)
                local bMaxZ = (tonumber(b.z) or 0.0) + (tonumber(b.supportTopRelZ) or tonumber(b.topRelZ) or 0.0)
                local verticalOverlap = aMinZ <= (bMaxZ + 0.008) and bMinZ <= (aMaxZ + 0.008)
                local broadphaseRadius = (((tonumber(a.radius) or 0.0) + (tonumber(b.radius) or 0.0)) * 2.35) + stackSupportPadding + safeGap + 0.055
                local broadphaseDx = (tonumber(b.x) or 0.0) - (tonumber(a.x) or 0.0)
                local broadphaseDy = (tonumber(b.y) or 0.0) - (tonumber(a.y) or 0.0)
                local broadphaseOverlap = ((broadphaseDx * broadphaseDx) + (broadphaseDy * broadphaseDy)) <= (broadphaseRadius * broadphaseRadius)
                local stackingFootprint = broadphaseOverlap and PT.FootprintsOverlapRelaxed(a, b, stackSupportPadding) or false
                local isStacking = stackingFootprint and (
                    bMinZ > (aMaxZ - stackOriginTopMargin)
                    or aMinZ > (bMaxZ - stackOriginTopMargin)
                )
                local collisionEnabled = not a.manipulating and not b.manipulating and not (a.sleeping == true and b.sleeping == true)
                if collisionEnabled and verticalOverlap and broadphaseOverlap and not isStacking then
                    local sep = PT.GetFootprintSeparation(a, b)
                    if sep then
                        local pushDepth = sep.depth + safeGap
                        local nx, ny = sep.nx, sep.ny
                        local aShare, bShare = 0.5, 0.5
                        local aPlayerMoved = PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved(a.prop)
                        local bPlayerMoved = PT.IsVisualPropPlayerMoved(b.prop)
                        if aPlayerMoved and not bPlayerMoved then
                            aShare, bShare = 0.0, 1.0
                        elseif bPlayerMoved and not aPlayerMoved then
                            aShare, bShare = 1.0, 0.0
                        elseif a.sleeping == true and b.sleeping ~= true then
                            aShare, bShare = 0.0, 1.0
                        elseif b.sleeping == true and a.sleeping ~= true then
                            aShare, bShare = 1.0, 0.0
                        end
                        local ax = nx * pushDepth
                        local ay = ny * pushDepth
                        if a.movable and (a.sleeping ~= true or aPlayerMoved or bPlayerMoved) and aShare > 0.0 then
                            a.x = a.x - (ax * aShare)
                            a.y = a.y - (ay * aShare)
                            a.yaw   = normalizeAngle180((a.yaw   or 0.0) - (yawImpulse   * angularDamping))
                            a.pitch = normalizeAngle180((a.pitch or 0.0) - (ny * pitchImpulse * angularDamping))
                            a.roll  = normalizeAngle180((a.roll  or 0.0) + (nx * rollImpulse  * angularDamping))
                            local angularA = PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[a.key] or { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, roll = 0.0 }
                            angularA.yaw   = (tonumber(angularA.yaw)   or 0.0) - (yawImpulse   * 0.18)
                            angularA.pitch = (tonumber(angularA.pitch) or 0.0) - (ny * pitchImpulse * 0.18)
                            angularA.roll  = (tonumber(angularA.roll)  or 0.0) + (nx * rollImpulse  * 0.18)
                            PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[a.key] = angularA
                            a.x, a.y = PT.ClampPropInsidePhysicsWalls(pctx, a.x, a.y, a.radius, a.prop, a.yaw, a.pitch, a.roll)
                            a.footprint = PT.GetVisualPropFootprintPoints(a.prop, a.x, a.y, a.yaw, a.pitch, a.roll)
                            refreshRecordSupportExtents(a)
                            a.dirty = true
                        end
                        if b.movable and (b.sleeping ~= true or bPlayerMoved or aPlayerMoved) and bShare > 0.0 then
                            b.x = b.x + (ax * bShare)
                            b.y = b.y + (ay * bShare)
                            b.yaw   = normalizeAngle180((b.yaw   or 0.0) + (yawImpulse   * angularDamping))
                            b.pitch = normalizeAngle180((b.pitch or 0.0) + (ny * pitchImpulse * angularDamping))
                            b.roll  = normalizeAngle180((b.roll  or 0.0) - (nx * rollImpulse  * angularDamping))
                            local angularB = PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[b.key] or { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, roll = 0.0 }
                            angularB.yaw   = (tonumber(angularB.yaw)   or 0.0) + (yawImpulse   * 0.18)
                            angularB.pitch = (tonumber(angularB.pitch) or 0.0) + (ny * pitchImpulse * 0.18)
                            angularB.roll  = (tonumber(angularB.roll)  or 0.0) - (nx * rollImpulse  * 0.18)
                            PT.VisualPhysicsState.angular[b.key] = angularB
                            b.x, b.y = PT.ClampPropInsidePhysicsWalls(pctx, b.x, b.y, b.radius, b.prop, b.yaw, b.pitch, b.roll)
                            b.footprint = PT.GetVisualPropFootprintPoints(b.prop, b.x, b.y, b.yaw, b.pitch, b.roll)
                            refreshRecordSupportExtents(b)
                            b.dirty = true
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end

    for _, rec in ipairs(records) do
        if not rec.manipulating then
            PT.SetPropPhysicsLocal(
                rec.prop,
                rec.x,
                rec.y,
                rec.z,
                tonumber(rec.yaw) or 0.0,
                tonumber(rec.pitch) or 0.0,
                tonumber(rec.roll) or 0.0,
                pctx
            )
            if rec.dirty then
                PT.MarkVisualPhysicsDirty(rec.prop)
            end
        end
    end

    PT.FlushSettledVisualPhysics()
end

-- d11_ptrunk (cliente): perfis por modelo, lado de acesso, camera e luz.
-- Porte de client/trunk.lua e client/camera.lua do velocity-physicaltrunk (D12), com os perfis em data/profiles.
PT = PT or {}

-- Os perfis vem dos arquivos de Config.ProfilePacks, na ordem (o de baixo vence); a tabela do servidor vale por cima.
-- Em cada arquivo, vehicles = { <modelo ou hash> = { spawn, camera, light } }; class e backEngine somam.
local Profiles = { spawn = {}, camera = {}, light = {}, class = {}, backEngine = {} }
PT.Profiles = Profiles

--- Um pack com `resource` so vale se algum resource rodando tem esse texto no nome (ex.: os carros do NoPixel).
local function packOn(pack)
    if not pack.resource then return true end
    local want = pack.resource:lower()
    for i = 0, GetNumResources() - 1 do
        local r = GetResourceByFindIndex(i)
        if r and r:lower():find(want, 1, true) and GetResourceState(r) == 'started' then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local backEngine = {}

--- Le os packs de novo (na entrada e quando o servidor manda os perfis: os carros do pack ja estao rodando ai).
local function loadPacks()
    for _, t in pairs(Profiles) do for k in pairs(t) do t[k] = nil end end
    for k in pairs(backEngine) do backEngine[k] = nil end
    for _, pack in ipairs(Config.ProfilePacks or {}) do
        local src = pack.file and LoadResourceFile(GetCurrentResourceName(), pack.file)
        local fn = src and load(src, '@' .. pack.file)
        local ok, data = false, nil
        if fn then ok, data = pcall(fn) end
        if not ok or type(data) ~= 'table' then
            print(('^3[d11_ptrunk] perfis: %s nao carregou (%s)^7'):format(tostring(pack.file), tostring(data or 'arquivo nao encontrado')))
        elseif packOn(pack) then
            for key, v in pairs(data.vehicles or {}) do
                local hash = type(key) == 'string' and joaat(key) or math.tointeger(key)
                if hash and type(v) == 'table' then
                    for _, kind in ipairs({ 'spawn', 'camera', 'light' }) do
                        if type(v[kind]) == 'table' then Profiles[kind][hash] = v[kind] end
                    end
                end
            end
            for cls, v in pairs(data.class or {}) do Profiles.class[cls] = v end
            for _, name in ipairs(data.backEngine or {}) do Profiles.backEngine[#Profiles.backEngine + 1] = name end
        end
    end
    for _, name in ipairs(Profiles.backEngine) do backEngine[joaat(name)] = true end
end
loadPacks()


local function clamp(v, lo, hi)
    if v < lo then return lo end
    if v > hi then return hi end
    return v
end

--- Perfil resolvido: o da classe com o do modelo por cima (camera, lado, ponto de pe).
function PT.ResolvedProfile(vehicle)
    local model = GetEntityModel(vehicle)
    local out = {}
    for k, v in pairs(Profiles.class[GetVehicleClass(vehicle)] or {}) do out[k] = v end
    for k, v in pairs(Profiles.camera[model] or {}) do out[k] = v end
    return out, model
end

--- Troca um perfil na hora (wizard, servidor). kind = 'camera' | 'spawn' | 'light'.
function PT.SetProfile(kind, hash, data)
    if Profiles[kind] and math.tointeger(hash) then Profiles[kind][math.tointeger(hash)] = data end
end

--- O que o servidor tem na tabela d11_ptrunk_profiles (wizard, /ptrunkimport) vale por cima do data/profiles.
local function applyServer(set)
    for kind in pairs({ camera = true, spawn = true, light = true }) do
        for hash, data in pairs(type(set) == 'table' and set[kind] or {}) do
            if type(data) == 'table' then PT.SetProfile(kind, tonumber(hash), data) end
        end
    end
end

local function fetchServerProfiles()
    CreateThread(function()
        local set = exports.whip_core:Callback('d11_ptrunk:profiles')
        loadPacks()
        applyServer(set)
    end)
end

Whip.register(fetchServerProfiles)
RegisterNetEvent('d11_ptrunk:client:profilesReload', fetchServerProfiles)

-- Um modelo recalibrado por alguem: { modelHash, camera?, spawn?, light? }.
RegisterNetEvent('d11_ptrunk:client:profiles', function(saved)
    if type(saved) ~= 'table' then return end
    for kind in pairs({ camera = true, spawn = true, light = true }) do
        if type(saved[kind]) == 'table' then PT.SetProfile(kind, tonumber(saved.modelHash), saved[kind]) end
    end
end)

function PT.SpawnProfile(vehicle) return Profiles.spawn[GetEntityModel(vehicle)] end
function PT.LightProfile(vehicle) return Profiles.light[GetEntityModel(vehicle)] end

--- Modo fisico so com a area util do modelo calibrada (decisao de 2026-11-17): sem ela, o porta-malas normal do WHIP.
--- Camera e luz sao opcionais: sem a do modelo, a camera vem da classe e o porta-malas fica sem luz propria.
function PT.HasFullProfile(vehicle)
    if not vehicle or vehicle == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(vehicle) then return false end
    return Profiles.spawn[GetEntityModel(vehicle)] ~= nil
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ acesso (client/trunk.lua da D12)
local function accessSide(vehicle)
    local p, model = PT.ResolvedProfile(vehicle)
    if p.access then return p.access end
    return backEngine[model] and 'front' or 'rear'
end

function PT.AccessY(vehicle)
    local mn, mx = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    return accessSide(vehicle) == 'front' and mx.y or mn.y
end

local function triggerRadius(vehicle)
    local p = PT.ResolvedProfile(vehicle)
    if p.triggerRadius then return p.triggerRadius end
    local mn, mx = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    local width, length = math.abs(mx.x - mn.x), math.abs(mx.y - mn.y)
    return math.max(Config.TrunkInteractDistance, math.min(3.0, 1.35 + width * 0.35 + length * 0.12))
end

function PT.AccessData(vehicle)
    return {
        access = accessSide(vehicle),
        coords = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, 0.0, PT.AccessY(vehicle), 0.0),
        triggerRadius = triggerRadius(vehicle),
    }
end

--- O jogador esta na area de carga (traseira, ou frente no motor traseiro)?
function PT.IsAtTrunk(vehicle)
    local a = PT.AccessData(vehicle)
    local pos = GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId())
    return #(vector2(pos.x, pos.y) - vector2(a.coords.x, a.coords.y)) <= a.triggerRadius
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera (client/camera.lua da D12)
local cam = nil

local function cameraParams(vehicle)
    local p = PT.ResolvedProfile(vehicle)
    local C = Config.Camera
    local mn, mx = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    local params = {
        access = accessSide(vehicle),
        fov = p.fov or C.fov,
        camLocalX = p.camLocalX, camLocalY = p.camLocalY, camLocalZ = p.camLocalZ,
        lookLocalX = p.lookLocalX, lookLocalY = p.lookLocalY, lookLocalZ = p.lookLocalZ,
        sideOffset = p.sideOffset or C.sideOffset,
        rearDistance = p.rearDistance or C.rearDistance,
        rearHeight = p.rearHeight or C.rearHeight,
        lookHeight = p.lookHeight or C.lookHeight,
    }
    local heightBias = clamp((math.abs(mx.z - mn.z) - 1.35) * 0.16, -0.12, 0.16)
    params.rearHeight = clamp(params.rearHeight + heightBias, 0.45, 1.15)
    params.lookHeight = clamp(params.lookHeight + heightBias * 0.65, 0.12, 0.82)
    params.rearDistance = clamp(params.rearDistance, -0.15, 1.2)
    params.sideOffset = clamp(params.sideOffset, -0.8, 0.8)
    params.fov = clamp(params.fov, 35.0, 90.0)
    return params
end

local function cameraPlacement(vehicle, params)
    if params.camLocalX and params.camLocalY and params.camLocalZ
        and params.lookLocalX and params.lookLocalY and params.lookLocalZ then
        return GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, params.camLocalX, params.camLocalY, params.camLocalZ),
            GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, params.lookLocalX, params.lookLocalY, params.lookLocalZ)
    end
    local dir = params.access == 'front' and 1.0 or -1.0
    local y = PT.AccessY(vehicle)
    return GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, params.sideOffset, y + dir * params.rearDistance, params.rearHeight),
        GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, 0.0, y, params.lookHeight)
end

function PT.CreateTrunkCamera(vehicle)
    PT.DestroyTrunkCamera(true)
    local params = cameraParams(vehicle)
    local from, look = cameraPlacement(vehicle, params)
    cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamCoord(cam, from.x, from.y, from.z)
    PointCamAtCoord(cam, look.x, look.y, look.z)
    SetCamFov(cam, params.fov)
    SetCamNearClip(cam, 0.02)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, Config.Camera.transitionMs, true, true)
    return cam
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera orbital do modo fisico (2026-11-16)
-- Pedido do usuario: em vez da camera fechada do perfil, uma camera mais aberta presa ao porta-malas, que o jogador
-- gira (botao direito arrastando) e aproxima/afasta (roda), dentro de limites. A direcao inicial e a da camera
-- calibrada do perfil, afastada por Config.Orbit.startScale; o alvo e o centro da area util.
local orbit = nil

function PT.CreateOrbitCamera(vehicle, area)
    PT.DestroyTrunkCamera(true)
    local O = Config.Orbit
    local params = cameraParams(vehicle)
    local from = cameraPlacement(vehicle, params)
    local t = vector3(area.x or 0.0, area.y or PT.AccessY(vehicle), area.z or 0.3)
    local d = GetOffsetFromEntityGivenWorldCoords(vehicle, from.x, from.y, from.z) - t
    local dist = math.max(0.5, #d)
    orbit = {
        vehicle = vehicle, target = t, dist = dist,
        baseYaw = math.deg(math.atan(d.x, d.y)), basePitch = math.deg(math.asin(clamp(d.z / dist, -1.0, 1.0))),
        want = { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, scale = O.startScale, px = 0.0, py = 0.0 },
        cur = { yaw = 0.0, pitch = 0.0, scale = O.startScale, px = 0.0, py = 0.0 },
    }
    cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamFov(cam, math.min(O.maxFov, params.fov + O.extraFov))
    SetCamNearClip(cam, 0.02)
    PT.OrbitTick(true)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, Config.Camera.transitionMs, true, true)
    return cam
end

--- Gira (dx, dy na fracao da tela que o mouse andou).
function PT.OrbitInput(dx, dy)
    if not orbit then return end
    local O = Config.Orbit
    local w = orbit.want
    w.yaw = clamp(w.yaw - dx * O.sensitivity, -O.yawLimit, O.yawLimit)
    w.pitch = clamp(w.pitch + dy * O.sensitivity * 0.6, O.pitchMin, O.pitchMax)
end

--- Move o ponto de foco (dx, dy na fracao da tela) pelo chao do carro, como arrastar um mapa: o que esta sob o cursor
--- vai junto com ele.
function PT.OrbitPan(dx, dy)
    if not orbit then return end
    local O = Config.Orbit
    local c, w = orbit.cur, orbit.want
    local yaw = math.rad(orbit.baseYaw + c.yaw)
    local fx, fy = -math.sin(yaw), -math.cos(yaw)   -- para onde a camera olha, no plano do carro
    local rx, ry = fy, -fx                           -- a direita da camera
    local k = O.panSpeed * orbit.dist * c.scale
    local px = w.px - rx * dx * k + fx * dy * k
    local py = w.py - ry * dx * k + fy * dy * k
    local len = math.sqrt(px * px + py * py)
    if len > O.panLimit then px, py = px / len * O.panLimit, py / len * O.panLimit end
    w.px, w.py = px, py
end

--- Volta o foco para o centro do porta-malas.
function PT.OrbitRecenter()
    if orbit then orbit.want.px, orbit.want.py = 0.0, 0.0 end
end

--- A vista inicial: sem giro, zoom de partida e foco no centro (suave, como o resto da orbita).
function PT.OrbitReset()
    if not orbit then return end
    local w = orbit.want
    w.yaw, w.pitch, w.scale, w.px, w.py = 0.0, 0.0, Config.Orbit.startScale, 0.0, 0.0
end

--- Roda do mouse: >0 afasta, <0 aproxima.
function PT.OrbitZoom(delta)
    if not orbit then return end
    local O = Config.Orbit
    orbit.want.scale = clamp(orbit.want.scale + (delta > 0 and O.zoomStep or -O.zoomStep), O.minScale, O.maxScale)
end

function PT.OrbitTick(instant)
    if not orbit or not cam or not DoesEntityExist(orbit.vehicle) then return end
    local a = instant and 1.0 or Config.Orbit.smooth
    local c, w = orbit.cur, orbit.want
    c.yaw = c.yaw + (w.yaw - c.yaw) * a
    c.pitch = c.pitch + (w.pitch - c.pitch) * a
    c.scale = c.scale + (w.scale - c.scale) * a
    c.px = c.px + (w.px - c.px) * a
    c.py = c.py + (w.py - c.py) * a
    local yaw = math.rad(orbit.baseYaw + c.yaw)
    local pitch = math.rad(clamp(orbit.basePitch + c.pitch, -5.0, 80.0))
    local dist = orbit.dist * c.scale
    local t = orbit.target + vector3(c.px, c.py, 0.0)
    local p = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(orbit.vehicle,
        t.x + math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch) * dist, t.y + math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch) * dist, t.z + math.sin(pitch) * dist)
    local look = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(orbit.vehicle, t.x, t.y, t.z)
    SetCamCoord(cam, p.x, p.y, p.z)
    PointCamAtCoord(cam, look.x, look.y, look.z)
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ camera orbital do jogador (chao livre)
-- Com o inventario aberto fora do porta-malas (pedido de 2026-11-16): girar (botao direito/meio) e afastar (roda).
-- A camera do jogo nao serve: o WHIP segura o "olhar" com o inventario aberto e ela trava ou desce sozinha. Esta nasce
-- exatamente onde a do jogo esta (sem pulo), segue o jogador, nao atravessa parede, e mantem a direcao do andar
-- (a camera do jogo, invisivel, acompanha o giro).
local porbit = nil

local function playerTarget()
    return GetEntityCoords(PlayerPedId()) + vector3(0.0, 0.0, Config.GroundFree.camera.height)
end

local function ensurePlayerOrbit()
    if porbit then return true end
    if cam then return false end   -- porta-malas ou calibracao com a camera
    local from = GetFinalRenderedCamCoord()
    local d = from - playerTarget()
    local P = Config.GroundFree.camera
    local dist = clamp(#d, P.minDist, P.maxDist)
    local yaw = math.deg(math.atan(d.x, d.y))
    local pitch = clamp(math.deg(math.asin(clamp(d.z / math.max(#d, 0.01), -1.0, 1.0))), P.pitchMin, P.pitchMax)
    porbit = { want = { yaw = yaw, pitch = pitch, dist = dist }, cur = { yaw = yaw, pitch = pitch, dist = dist } }
    cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamFov(cam, GetFinalRenderedCamFov())
    SetCamNearClip(cam, 0.02)
    PT.PlayerOrbitTick(true)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, false, 0, true, true)
    return true
end

--- Gira (dx, dy: fracao da tela que o mouse andou com o botao segurado).
function PT.PlayerOrbitInput(dx, dy)
    if not ensurePlayerOrbit() then return end
    local P = Config.GroundFree.camera
    local w = porbit.want
    w.yaw = w.yaw - dx * P.sensitivity
    w.pitch = clamp(w.pitch + dy * P.sensitivity * 0.6, P.pitchMin, P.pitchMax)
end

--- Roda do mouse: > 0 afasta, < 0 aproxima.
function PT.PlayerOrbitZoom(delta)
    if not ensurePlayerOrbit() then return end
    local P = Config.GroundFree.camera
    porbit.want.dist = clamp(porbit.want.dist + (delta > 0 and P.zoomStep or -P.zoomStep), P.minDist, P.maxDist)
end

function PT.PlayerOrbitTick(instant)
    if not porbit or not cam then return end
    local a = instant and 1.0 or Config.GroundFree.camera.smooth
    local c, w = porbit.cur, porbit.want
    c.yaw = c.yaw + (w.yaw - c.yaw) * a
    c.pitch = c.pitch + (w.pitch - c.pitch) * a
    c.dist = c.dist + (w.dist - c.dist) * a
    local t = playerTarget()
    local yaw, pitch = math.rad(c.yaw), math.rad(c.pitch)
    local dir = vector3(math.sin(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.cos(yaw) * math.cos(pitch), math.sin(pitch))
    local dist = c.dist
    -- Sem atravessar parede: encosta um pouco antes do que estiver entre o jogador e a camera.
    local far = t + dir * dist
    local h = StartExpensiveSynchronousShapeTestLosProbe(t.x, t.y, t.z, far.x, far.y, far.z, 1 | 16, PlayerPedId(), 7)
    local _, hit, at = GetShapeTestResult(h)
    if hit == 1 then dist = math.max(0.3, #(at - t) - 0.2) end
    local p = t + dir * dist
    SetCamCoord(cam, p.x, p.y, p.z)
    PointCamAtCoord(cam, t.x, t.y, t.z)
    -- A camera do jogo olha para o mesmo lado: WASD anda para onde se ve, e a volta ao fechar nao pula.
    local heading = (180.0 - c.yaw) - GetEntityHeading(PlayerPedId())
    SetGameplayCamRelativeHeading((heading + 540.0) % 360.0 - 180.0)
end

--- Volta para a camera do jogo (fechar o inventario, entrar no porta-malas); instant: sem transicao (parar o resource).
function PT.DestroyPlayerOrbit(instant)
    if not porbit then return end
    porbit = nil
    if not cam then return end
    RenderScriptCams(false, not instant, instant and 0 or Config.GroundFree.camera.exitMs, true, true)
    DestroyCam(cam, false)
    cam = nil
end

--- instant: sem a transicao de volta (trocar de camera, parar o resource).
function PT.DestroyTrunkCamera(instant)
    orbit = nil
    porbit = nil
    if not cam then return end
    RenderScriptCams(false, not instant, instant and 0 or Config.Camera.transitionMs, true, true)
    DestroyCam(cam, false)
    cam = nil
end

function PT.ActiveCamera() return cam end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ calibracao (camera livre, client/camera.lua da D12)
function PT.RotationToDirection(rot)
    local x, z = math.rad(rot.x), math.rad(rot.z)
    return vector3(-math.sin(z) * math.abs(math.cos(x)), math.cos(z) * math.abs(math.cos(x)), math.sin(x))
end

function PT.RotationFromPoints(from, to)
    local d = to - from
    local flat = math.sqrt(d.x * d.x + d.y * d.y)
    return vector3(-math.deg(math.atan(d.z, flat)), 0.0, math.deg(math.atan(d.x, d.y)))
end

--- Camera e alvo do perfil atual (no mundo) e o fov: ponto de partida da camera livre da calibracao.
function PT.CameraPlacement(vehicle)
    local params = cameraParams(vehicle)
    local from, look = cameraPlacement(vehicle, params)
    return from, look, params.fov
end

function PT.CreateFreeCamera(pos, rot, fov)
    PT.DestroyTrunkCamera(true)
    cam = CreateCam('DEFAULT_SCRIPTED_CAMERA', true)
    SetCamCoord(cam, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    SetCamRot(cam, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2)
    SetCamFov(cam, fov or Config.Camera.fov)
    SetCamNearClip(cam, 0.02)
    SetCamActive(cam, true)
    RenderScriptCams(true, true, Config.Camera.transitionMs, true, true)
    return cam
end

function PT.SetFreeCameraTransform(pos, rot, fov)
    if not cam then return end
    SetCamCoord(cam, pos.x, pos.y, pos.z)
    SetCamRot(cam, rot.x, rot.y, rot.z, 2)
    SetCamFov(cam, fov or Config.Camera.fov)
end

--- Distancia do ponto de pe ate o acesso (getStandOffset da D12).
function PT.StandOffset(vehicle)
    local p = PT.ResolvedProfile(vehicle)
    if p.standOffset then return p.standOffset end
    local mn, mx = GetModelDimensions(GetEntityModel(vehicle))
    return math.max(1.35, math.min(2.0, 1.15 + math.abs(mx.y - mn.y) * 0.12))
end

-- ------------------------------------------------------------------ luz
function PT.DrawTrunkLight(vehicle)
    local profile = PT.LightProfile(vehicle)
    if not profile or not profile.spots then return end
    local D = Config.TrunkLight
    for _, s in ipairs(profile.spots) do
        local pos = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, s.pos.x, s.pos.y, s.pos.z)
        local look = GetOffsetFromEntityInWorldCoords(vehicle, s.look.x, s.look.y, s.look.z)
        local d = look - pos
        local len = #d
        if len > 0.0001 then
            local n = d / len
            local c = s.color or { r = 255, g = 235, b = 190 }
            DrawSpotLight(pos.x, pos.y, pos.z, n.x, n.y, n.z, c.r or 255, c.g or 235, c.b or 190,
                s.distance or D.distance, s.brightness or D.brightness, s.roundness or D.roundness,
                s.spotFov or s.radius or D.radius, s.falloff or D.falloff)
        end
    end
end

-- Keeps a /roupascan result as data/scan-<body>.json. Only for players with the 'command' ace (admins).
local RES = GetCurrentResourceName()
local MAX = 20 * 1024 * 1024

RegisterNetEvent('d11_wardrobe:scan', function(body, payload)
    local src = source
    if not IsPlayerAceAllowed(src, 'command') then
        TriggerClientEvent('d11_wardrobe:scanSaved', src, body, nil, false, 'sem permissão (ace command)')
        return
    end
    if body ~= 'male' and body ~= 'female' then return end
    if type(payload) ~= 'string' or #payload > MAX then
        TriggerClientEvent('d11_wardrobe:scanSaved', src, body, nil, false, 'resultado grande demais')
        return
    end
    local ok = pcall(json.decode, payload)
    if not ok then
        TriggerClientEvent('d11_wardrobe:scanSaved', src, body, nil, false, 'resultado ilegível')
        return
    end
    local path = ('data/scan-%s.json'):format(body)
    local saved = SaveResourceFile(RES, path, payload, -1)
    print(('[d11_wardrobe] scan %s de %s: %s (%d KB)'):format(body, GetPlayerName(src) or src,
        saved and 'salvo' or 'FALHOU', math.floor(#payload / 1024)))
    TriggerClientEvent('d11_wardrobe:scanSaved', src, body, RES .. '/' .. path, saved, 'SaveResourceFile falhou')
end)

-- Framework bridge (server). Only used by job-locked screens (Config.Locations[].locked.jobs).
-- Adapt it if your server uses a custom framework or job system.

Bridge = {}

local function detect()
    if Config.Framework ~= 'auto' then return Config.Framework end
    if GetResourceState('qbx_core') == 'started' then return 'qbox' end
    if GetResourceState('qb-core') == 'started' then return 'qb' end
    if GetResourceState('es_extended') == 'started' then return 'esx' end
    return 'standalone'
end

Bridge.name = detect()

-- Returns the player's job name and grade, or nil.
if Bridge.name == 'esx' then
    local ESX = exports.es_extended:getSharedObject()

    function Bridge.GetJob(src)
        local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(src)
        local job = xPlayer and xPlayer.job
        if not job then return nil end
        return job.name, tonumber(job.grade) or 0
    end
elseif Bridge.name == 'qb' or Bridge.name == 'qbox' then
    local getPlayer
    if Bridge.name == 'qbox' then

-- Scenario Share's screen: /scenarioshare (Director builders). The page (html/) packs and unpacks codes;
-- the server reads scenarios and makes imports. A code goes up in pieces: a big plain message never arrives.

local PART = 7000
local open = false

local function close()
    if not open then return end
    open = false
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
    exports.whip_core:SetScreenOpen(false)
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'close' })
end

RegisterCommand('scenarioshare', function()
    if open then return end
    CreateThread(function()
        local data, why = exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:open')
        if type(data) ~= 'table' then
            exports.whip_core:Notify(why or 'Scenario Share is for Director builders', 'error')
            return
        end
        open = true
        exports.whip_core:SetScreenOpen(true)
        SetNuiFocus(true, true)
        SendNUIMessage({ action = 'open', data = data })
    end)
end, false)

--- A callback's answer for the page: { ok = true, data } or { ok = false, why }.
local function answer(data, why)
    if data == false or data == nil then return { ok = false, why = why or 'No answer from the server' } end
    return { ok = true, data = data }
end

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    close()
    cb({ ok = true })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('refresh', function(_, cb)
    CreateThread(function() cb(answer(exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:open'))) end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('share', function(body, cb)
    CreateThread(function()
        cb(answer(exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:share', tostring(body and body.key or ''), 0)))
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('import', function(body, cb)
    CreateThread(function()
        local code = type(body) == 'table' and type(body.code) == 'string' and body.code or ''
        if code == '' then return cb({ ok = false, why = 'Paste a code first' }) end
        local total = math.ceil(#code / PART)
        for i = 1, total do
            local got, why = exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:part', i, total, code:sub((i - 1) * PART + 1, i * PART))
            if not got then return cb({ ok = false, why = why or 'The code did not all arrive' }) end
        end
        cb(answer(exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:import', type(body.name) == 'string' and body.name or '')))
    end)
end)

RegisterNUICallback('remove', function(body, cb)
    CreateThread(function()
        cb(answer(exports.whip_core:Callback('zext_scenario_share:remove', tostring(body and body.name or ''))))
    end)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(res)
    if res == GetCurrentResourceName() and open then SetNuiFocus(false, false) end
end)

    local res = GetCurrentResourceName()
    local runLock = LoadResourceFile(res, "run.lock")
    local hasCoreRunLock = runLock and runLock:match("^core")
    local hasPluginRunLock = runLock and runLock:match("^plugin")

    -- Check both convar and run.lock for backward compatibility.
    -- Older updater versions signal only with run.lock.
    if action == "core" or action == "plugin" or hasCoreRunLock or hasPluginRunLock then
        SetConvar(helperSignalKey, "")
        os.remove(GetResourcePath(res).."/run.lock")

        local restartAction = action
        if restartAction ~= "core" and restartAction ~= "plugin" then
            if hasCoreRunLock then
                restartAction = "core"
            elseif hasPluginRunLock then
                restartAction = "plugin"
            end
        end

        ExecuteCommand("refresh")
        Wait(1000)
        if restartAction == "core" then
            for k, v in pairs(ManagedResources) do
                if GetResourceState(v) ~= "started" then
                    print(("Not restarting resource %s as it is not started. This may be fine. State: %s"):format(v, GetResourceState(v)))
                else
                    ExecuteCommand("restart "..v)
                    Wait(1000)
                end
            end
        elseif restartAction == "plugin" then
            print("Restarting sonorancad resource for plugin updates...")
            if GetResourceState("sonorancad") ~= "started" then
                print(("Not restarting resource %s as it is not in the started state to avoid server crashing. State: %s"):format("sonorancad", GetResourceState("sonorancad")))
                print("If you are seeing this message, you have started sonoran_updatehelper in your configuration which is incorrect. Please do not start sonoran_updatehelper manually.")
                return
            else
                ExecuteCommand("restart sonorancad")
            end
        end
    else
        os.remove(GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/run.lock")
        print("sonoran_updatehelper is for internal use and should not be started as a resource.")
    end
    os.remove(GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/run.lock")
end)

-- Client: finds screens, renders the closest ones (one DUI each) and keeps them in sync with the server.

lib.locale()

TV = {
    states = {},
    localMute = false,
    listeners = {},
}

local runtimes = {}
local activeRuntimeIds = {}
local modelLookup = {}
local modelHashes = {}
local nearestTv
local currentBucket = 0
local playerErrors = {}
local reportedTokens = {}
local reportedErrors = {}
local registeredRenderTargets = {}
local spawnedProps = {}
local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local playback = Config.Playback

local creating = {}
local scanInterval = 750
local falloffStart = 1.5 -- metres at full volume; then it fades out up to the model's drawDistance
local helpDistance = 2.0
local driftTolerance = 3.0 -- seconds before a screen jumps back in sync
local driftCheckInterval = 15000
local stateRefreshInterval = 60000 -- full re-sync in case an event was lost; bucket changes are instant

local function normalizeHash(hash)
    hash = tonumber(hash)
    if not hash then return nil end
    if hash < 0 then return hash + 4294967296 end
    return hash
end

for _, definition in ipairs(Config.Models) do
    definition.hash = definition.hash or joaat(definition.model)
    definition.label = definition.label or definition.model
    modelLookup[normalizeHash(definition.hash)] = definition
    modelHashes[#modelHashes + 1] = definition.hash
end

local function debugPrint(...)
    if Config.Debug then print(('[%s]'):format(resourceName), ...) end
end

function TV.notify(key, kind, ...)
    lib.notify({ title = Config.UI.brand .. ' ' .. Config.UI.title, description = locale(key, ...), type = kind or 'inform' })
end

local function distanceBetween(a, b)
    local dx, dy, dz = a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

function TV.definitionFor(model)
    return modelLookup[normalizeHash(model)]
end

function TV.currentTime(state)
    local current = tonumber(state.currentTime) or 0
    if state.playing and state.receivedAt then
        current = current + math.max(0, GetGameTimer() - state.receivedAt) / 1000
    end
    if state.duration then current = math.min(current, state.duration) end
    return current
end

function TV.findState(tv)
    if not tv then return nil end
    local model = normalizeHash(tv.model)
    for _, state in pairs(TV.states) do
        if normalizeHash(state.model) == model and distanceBetween(state.coords, tv.coords) <= 0.75 then
            return state
        end
    end
end

function TV.descriptor(tv)
    return { model = tv.model, coords = { x = tv.coords.x, y = tv.coords.y, z = tv.coords.z } }
end

function TV.fromEntity(entity)
    if not entity or entity == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(entity) then return nil end
    local model = GetEntityModel(entity)
    local definition = TV.definitionFor(model)
    if not definition then return nil end
    local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
    return {
        entity = entity,
        model = model,
        coords = coords,
        definition = definition,
        distance = #(GetEntityCoords(cache.ped) - coords),
    }
end

function TV.nearest()
    return nearestTv
end

local function emit(id)
    for _, listener in ipairs(TV.listeners) do listener(id) end
end

-- DUI RUNTIMES -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local playerTextKeys = {
    'player_waiting', 'player_loading', 'player_failed', 'player_no_detail', 'player_code',
    'player_yt_2', 'player_yt_5', 'player_yt_100', 'player_yt_101', 'player_yt_153', 'player_yt_other',
    'player_api_failed', 'player_direct_failed', 'player_stream_failed', 'player_vimeo_failed', 'player_autoplay',
    'player_unsupported', 'kind_youtube', 'kind_vimeo', 'kind_archive', 'kind_direct', 'kind_hls',
}

local playerTexts
local function getPlayerTexts()
    if not playerTexts then
        playerTexts = {}
        for _, key in ipairs(playerTextKeys) do playerTexts[key] = locale(key) end
    end
    return playerTexts
end

local function sendRuntimeMessage(runtime, action, volume)
    local state = TV.states[runtime.id]
    if not state or not runtime.dui or not IsDuiAvailable(runtime.dui) then return end

    SendDuiMessage(runtime.dui, json.encode({
        action = action,
        screenId = state.id,
        mediaToken = state.mediaToken,
        media = state.media,
        playing = state.playing,
        currentTime = TV.currentTime(state),
        volume = volume or runtime.lastVolume or state.volume,
        driftTolerance = driftTolerance,
        ui = action == 'load' and Config.UI or nil,
        texts = action == 'load' and getPlayerTexts() or nil,
    }))
end

local function destroyRuntime(id)
    local runtime = runtimes[id]
    if not runtime then return end
    if runtime.dui then DestroyDui(runtime.dui) end
    runtimes[id] = nil
    activeRuntimeIds[id] = nil
end

local function registerRenderTarget(definition, model)
    local name = definition.renderTarget
    if not IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(name) then RegisterNamedRendertarget(name, false) end
    if not IsNamedRendertargetLinked(model) then LinkNamedRendertarget(model) end
    if not IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(name) then return nil end
    registeredRenderTargets[name] = true
    return GetNamedRendertargetRenderId(name)
end

local function playerUrl()
    if playback.playerUrl and playback.playerUrl ~= '' then return playback.playerUrl end
    return ('https://cfx-nui-%s/ui/player/player.html'):format(resourceName)
end

local function createRuntime(state, definition)
    if runtimes[state.id] then return runtimes[state.id] end

    local renderId = registerRenderTarget(definition, state.model)
    if not renderId or renderId == 0 then
        print(('[%s] Could not register render target %s for %s.'):format(resourceName, definition.renderTarget, definition.label))
        return nil
    end

    local dui = CreateDui(playerUrl(), 1280, 720)
    if not dui then return nil end

    local timeout = GetGameTimer() + 10000
    while not IsDuiAvailable(dui) and GetGameTimer() < timeout do Wait(50) end
    if not IsDuiAvailable(dui) then
        DestroyDui(dui)
        print(('[%s] DUI was not available for screen %s.'):format(resourceName, state.id))
        return nil
    end

    local suffix = tostring(normalizeHash(joaat(state.id)))
    local txdName, textureName = 'xex_tv_' .. suffix, 'screen_' .. suffix
    CreateRuntimeTextureFromDuiHandle(CreateRuntimeTxd(txdName), textureName, GetDuiHandle(dui))

    local runtime = {
        id = state.id,
        dui = dui,
        txdName = txdName,
        textureName = textureName,
        renderId = renderId,
        lastVolume = 0,
    }
    runtimes[state.id] = runtime
    sendRuntimeMessage(runtime, 'load', 0)
    return runtime
end

local function updateState(payload)
    if type(payload) ~= 'table' or not payload.id then return end
    payload.receivedAt = GetGameTimer()
    TV.states[payload.id] = payload

    local runtime = runtimes[payload.id]
    if runtime then sendRuntimeMessage(runtime, 'sync', runtime.lastVolume) end
    emit(payload.id)
end

RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:syncAll', function(payload, bucket)
    payload = type(payload) == 'table' and payload or {}
    currentBucket = tonumber(bucket) or 0

    for id in pairs(runtimes) do
        if not payload[id] then destroyRuntime(id) end
    end

    TV.states = {}
    for _, state in pairs(payload) do updateState(state) end
    emit(nil)
end)

TV.applyState = updateState

RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:syncOne', updateState)

RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:removeOne', function(id)
    TV.states[id] = nil
    playerErrors[id] = nil
    destroyRuntime(id)
    emit(id)
end)

-- Walls: compares the player's interior and room with the screen's. Outdoors both are 0.
local function roomFactor(entity)
    local room = playback.roomAudio
    if not room or not room.enabled or not entity then return 1.0 end

    local pedInterior, screenInterior = GetInteriorFromEntity(cache.ped), GetInteriorFromEntity(entity)
    if pedInterior ~= screenInterior then return room.otherInterior or 0.1 end
    if pedInterior ~= 0 and GetRoomKeyFromEntity(cache.ped) ~= GetRoomKeyFromEntity(entity) then
        return room.otherRoom or 0.4
    end
    return 1.0
end

local function effectiveVolume(state, definition, distance, entity)
    if TV.localMute then return 0 end
    local start = falloffStart
    local maxDistance = math.max(start + 0.1, definition.drawDistance)
    local factor = 1.0
    if distance > start then
        factor = math.max(0.0, math.min(1.0, 1.0 - (distance - start) / (maxDistance - start)))
    end
    return math.floor(state.volume * factor * factor * roomFactor(entity) + 0.5)
end

-- Picks the closest screens (one per render target, as GTA shares a render target per model)
-- and keeps a DUI only for those.
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        local byRenderTarget = {}

        for id, state in pairs(TV.states) do
            local definition = TV.definitionFor(state.model)
            if definition then
                local distance = distanceBetween(playerCoords, state.coords)
                if distance <= definition.drawDistance then
                    local entity = GetClosestObjectOfType(state.coords.x, state.coords.y, state.coords.z, 3.0,
                        state.model, false, false, false)
                    if entity ~= 0 then
                        local current = byRenderTarget[definition.renderTarget]
                        if not current or distance < current.distance then
                            byRenderTarget[definition.renderTarget] = {
                                id = id, state = state, definition = definition, distance = distance, entity = entity,
                            }
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        local selected = {}
        for _, candidate in pairs(byRenderTarget) do selected[#selected + 1] = candidate end
        table.sort(selected, function(a, b) return a.distance < b.distance end)

        local desired = {}
        for index = 1, math.min(#selected, playback.maxConcurrentScreens) do
            local candidate = selected[index]
            local runtime = runtimes[candidate.id]
            -- A new DUI can take seconds to load: create it aside so the other screens keep updating.
            if not runtime and not creating[candidate.id] then
                creating[candidate.id] = true
                CreateThread(function()
                    createRuntime(candidate.state, candidate.definition)
                    creating[candidate.id] = nil
                end)
            end
            if runtime then
                desired[candidate.id] = true
                local volume = effectiveVolume(candidate.state, candidate.definition, candidate.distance, candidate.entity)
                if math.abs((runtime.lastVolume or -1) - volume) >= 2 or (volume == 0) ~= (runtime.lastVolume == 0) then
                    runtime.lastVolume = volume
                    sendRuntimeMessage(runtime, 'sync', volume)
                end
            end
        end

        activeRuntimeIds = desired
        for id in pairs(runtimes) do
            if not desired[id] then destroyRuntime(id) end
        end

        Wait(scanInterval)
    end
end)

-- Drawing to a render target has to happen every frame, but only while a screen is active.
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        if next(activeRuntimeIds) then
            for id in pairs(activeRuntimeIds) do
                local runtime = runtimes[id]
                if runtime and runtime.renderId ~= 0 then
                    SetTextRenderId(runtime.renderId)
                    SetScriptGfxDrawOrder(4)
                    DrawSprite(runtime.txdName, runtime.textureName, 0.5, 0.5, 1.0, 1.0, 0.0, 255, 255, 255, 255)
                    SetTextRenderId(1)
                end
            end
            Wait(0)
        else
            Wait(250)
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(driftCheckInterval)
        for id in pairs(activeRuntimeIds) do
            local runtime = runtimes[id]
            if runtime then sendRuntimeMessage(runtime, 'sync', runtime.lastVolume) end
        end
    end
end)

CreateThread(function()
    while not NetworkIsSessionStarted() do Wait(500) end
    TriggerServerEvent('xex_tv:requestState')
    while true do
        Wait(stateRefreshInterval)
        TriggerServerEvent('xex_tv:requestState')
    end
end)

-- Events coming from the DUI players.
RegisterNUICallback('playerEvent', function(data, cb)
    cb({ ok = true })
    if type(data) ~= 'table' or not data.screenId then return end

    if data.event == 'error' or data.event == 'warning' then
        playerErrors[data.screenId] = { code = data.code, detail = data.detail or data.title }
        local line = ('screen %s: %s - %s'):format(data.screenId, tostring(data.code), tostring(data.detail or data.title))
        if data.event == 'error' then print(('[%s] %s'):format(resourceName, line)) else debugPrint(line) end

        -- A channel that can't play here: the server moves it on once it trusts the report.
        local state = TV.states[data.screenId]
        if data.event == 'error' and state and state.channel and state.mediaToken == data.mediaToken
            and not reportedErrors[data.mediaToken]
        then
            reportedErrors[data.mediaToken] = true
            TriggerServerEvent('xex_tv:mediaError', data.screenId, data.mediaToken, tostring(data.code))
        end
    elseif data.event == 'media' then
        local state = TV.states[data.screenId]
        if state and state.mediaToken == data.mediaToken and not reportedTokens[data.mediaToken] then
            reportedTokens[data.mediaToken] = true
            TriggerServerEvent('xex_tv:mediaInfo', data.screenId, data.mediaToken, {
                duration = tonumber(data.duration),
                title = type(data.title) == 'string' and data.title:sub(1, 400) or nil,
                live = data.live == true,
            })
        end
    elseif data.event then
        debugPrint(('screen %s: %s'):format(data.screenId, data.event))
    end
end)

-- NEAREST SCREEN ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CreateThread(function()
    local controlDistance = Config.Interaction.controlDistance
    while true do
        local playerCoords = GetEntityCoords(cache.ped)
        local closest

        for _, definition in ipairs(Config.Models) do
            local entity = GetClosestObjectOfType(playerCoords.x, playerCoords.y, playerCoords.z, controlDistance,
                definition.hash, false, false, false)
            if entity ~= 0 then
                local coords = GetEntityCoords(entity)
                local distance = #(playerCoords - coords)
                if distance <= controlDistance and (not closest or distance < closest.distance) then
                    closest = { entity = entity, model = GetEntityModel(entity), coords = coords, definition = definition, distance = distance }
                end
            end
        end

        nearestTv = closest
        Wait(scanInterval)
    end
end)

-- FIXED SCREENS (spawned props) --------------------------------------------------------------------

for index, location in ipairs(Config.Locations) do
    if location.spawn then
        local model = location.hash or joaat(location.model)
        lib.points.new({
            coords = location.coords,
            distance = math.max(50.0, (TV.definitionFor(model) or {}).drawDistance or 0) + 20.0,
            onEnter = function()
                if spawnedProps[index] then return end
                lib.requestModel(model)
                -- Local object at the exact config position, so every player resolves the same screen.
                local object = CreateObjectNoOffset(model, location.coords.x, location.coords.y, location.coords.z, false, false, false)
                SetEntityHeading(object, location.heading or 0.0)
                FreezeEntityPosition(object, true)
                SetModelAsNoLongerNeeded(model)
                spawnedProps[index] = object
            end,
            onExit = function()
                local object = spawnedProps[index]
                if object and DoesEntityExist(object) then DeleteObject(object) end
                spawnedProps[index] = nil
            end,
        })
    end
end

-- INTERACTION ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local interaction = Config.Interaction

if interaction.command then
    RegisterCommand(interaction.command, function() TV.openRemote(nearestTv) end, false)
end

local keybind
if interaction.key then
    keybind = lib.addKeybind({
        name = 'xex_tv_remote',
        description = locale('keybind'),
        defaultKey = interaction.key,
        onReleased = function()
            if nearestTv and nearestTv.distance <= helpDistance and not IsNuiFocused() then
                TV.openRemote(nearestTv)
            end
        end,
    })
end

local targetSystem
CreateThread(function()
    if not interaction.target then return end
    if GetResourceState('ox_target') == 'started' then
        targetSystem = 'ox'
        exports.ox_target:addModel(modelHashes, {
            {
                name = 'xex_tv_remote',
                icon = 'fa-solid fa-tv',
                label = locale('target'),
                distance = interaction.controlDistance,
                onSelect = function(data) TV.openRemote(TV.fromEntity(data.entity)) end,
            },
        })
    elseif GetResourceState('qb-target') == 'started' then
        targetSystem = 'qb'
        exports['qb-target']:AddTargetModel(modelHashes, {
            options = {
                { icon = 'fas fa-tv', label = locale('target'), action = function(entity) TV.openRemote(TV.fromEntity(entity)) end },
            },
            distance = interaction.controlDistance,
        })
    end
end)

if interaction.help then
    CreateThread(function()
        local helpEntity
        if targetSystem or not (keybind or interaction.command) then return end
        while true do
            if nearestTv and nearestTv.distance <= helpDistance then
                if helpEntity ~= nearestTv.entity then
                    helpEntity = nearestTv.entity
                    -- The key players actually use, after any rebind in the game settings.
                    local text = keybind and locale('help_key', keybind:getCurrentKey())
                        or locale('help_command', interaction.command)
                    BeginTextCommandDisplayHelp('STRING')
                    AddTextComponentSubstringPlayerName(text)
                    EndTextCommandDisplayHelp(0, false, false, 5000)
                end
            elseif helpEntity then
                helpEntity = nil
            end
            Wait(500)
        end
    end)
end

if interaction.debugCommand then
    RegisterCommand(interaction.debugCommand, function()
        local tv = nearestTv
        if not tv then return TV.notify('no_tv', 'error') end

        local state = TV.findState(tv)
        local err = state and playerErrors[state.id]
        local lines = {
            ('Model: %s (%s)'):format(tv.definition.label, tv.model),
            ('Render target: %s'):format(tv.definition.renderTarget),
            ('Coords: %.2f, %.2f, %.2f'):format(tv.coords.x, tv.coords.y, tv.coords.z),
            ('Bucket: %s'):format(currentBucket),
            ('Media: %s'):format(state and state.media and (state.media.kind .. ' · ' .. (state.media.label or '')) or 'off'),
            ('Rendering: %s'):format(state and runtimes[state.id] and 'yes' or 'no'),
            ('Last player error: %s'):format(err and (tostring(err.code) .. ' · ' .. tostring(err.detail)) or 'none'),
        }
        local text = table.concat(lines, '\n')
        print(('[%s]\n%s'):format(resourceName, text))
        lib.alertDialog({ header = Config.UI.brand .. ' ' .. Config.UI.title, content = text, centered = true })
    end, false)
end

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name)
    if name ~= resourceName then return end
    for id in pairs(runtimes) do destroyRuntime(id) end
    for renderTarget in pairs(registeredRenderTargets) do
        if IsNamedRendertargetRegistered(renderTarget) then ReleaseNamedRendertarget(renderTarget) end
    end
    for _, object in pairs(spawnedProps) do
        if DoesEntityExist(object) then DeleteObject(object) end
    end
    if targetSystem == 'ox' then
        exports.ox_target:removeModel(modelHashes, 'xex_tv_remote')
    elseif targetSystem == 'qb' then
        exports['qb-target']:RemoveTargetModel(modelHashes, locale('target'))
    end
end)

-- Remote control (NUI) for the screen it was opened on.

local opened -- { tv = <screen>, canControl = bool }

local textKeys = {
    'ui_off', 'ui_paste', 'ui_play', 'ui_add_queue', 'ui_queue', 'ui_queue_empty', 'ui_channels',
    'ui_volume', 'ui_loop', 'ui_next', 'ui_pause', 'ui_resume', 'ui_stop', 'ui_resync', 'ui_mute_me',
    'ui_locked', 'ui_started_by', 'ui_live', 'ui_sources', 'ui_close', 'ui_remove',
    'ui_library', 'ui_library_note', 'ui_library_search', 'ui_search', 'ui_featured', 'ui_results',
    'ui_load_more', 'ui_no_results', 'ui_searching', 'ui_watch', 'ui_queue_short',
    'ui_on_air', 'ui_starting', 'ui_channel_note', 'ui_guide_open', 'ui_guide_note', 'ui_all', 'ui_ch_up', 'ui_ch_down',
    'genre_noir', 'genre_horror', 'genre_comedy', 'genre_western', 'genre_scifi', 'genre_silent', 'genre_animation',
    'category_news', 'category_sports', 'category_music', 'category_movies', 'category_kids', 'category_nature',
    'category_documentary', 'category_entertainment',
    'kind_youtube', 'kind_vimeo', 'kind_archive', 'kind_direct', 'kind_hls',
}

-- Must match Library.genres on the server.
local genres = { 'noir', 'horror', 'comedy', 'western', 'scifi', 'silent', 'animation' }

local function texts()
    local out = {}
    for _, key in ipairs(textKeys) do out[key] = locale(key) end
    return out
end

local function stateForUi()
    local state = opened and TV.findState(opened.tv)
    if not state then return false end
    local copy = {}
    for key, value in pairs(state) do copy[key] = value end
    copy.currentTime = TV.currentTime(state)
    copy.receivedAt = nil
    return copy
end

local function pushState()
    if not opened then return end
    SendNUIMessage({ action = 'state', state = stateForUi(), localMute = TV.localMute })
end

TV.listeners[#TV.listeners + 1] = function()
    pushState()
end

local function openRemote(tv)
    if opened then return end
    if not tv then return TV.notify('no_tv', 'error') end

    local info = lib.callback.await('xex_tv:inspect', false, TV.descriptor(tv))
    if type(info) ~= 'table' or not info.ok then
        return TV.notify(type(info) == 'table' and info.message or 'error', 'error')
    end
    if info.screen then TV.applyState(info.screen) end

    opened = { tv = tv, canControl = info.canControl == true }
    SetNuiFocus(true, true)
    SendNUIMessage({
        action = 'open',
        ui = Config.UI,
        texts = texts(),
        screenLabel = info.label,
        canControl = opened.canControl,
        queue = Config.Queue,
        channels = type(info.channels) == 'table' and info.channels or {},
        -- What the link field accepts, shown under it.
        sources = {
            youtube = Config.Sources.youtube == true,
            vimeo = Config.Sources.vimeo == true,
            archive = Config.Library ~= nil and Config.Library.enabled == true,
            direct = #Config.AllowedMediaHosts > 0,
        },
        library = Config.Library and Config.Library.enabled and { genres = genres } or false,
        state = stateForUi(),
        localMute = TV.localMute,
    })
end

-- Called from commands, targets and keybinds: run in a thread so the server callback can be awaited.
function TV.openRemote(tv)
    CreateThread(function() openRemote(tv) end)
end

local function closeRemote()
    opened = nil
    SetNuiFocus(false, false)
end

RegisterNUICallback('action', function(data, cb)
    if not opened or type(data) ~= 'table' or type(data.action) ~= 'string' then return cb({ ok = false }) end

    local result = lib.callback.await('xex_tv:action', false, data.action, TV.descriptor(opened.tv), data.value)
    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, message = locale('error') }) end
    if result.screen then TV.applyState(result.screen) end

    cb({ ok = result.ok == true, message = locale(result.message or 'error') })
    pushState()
end)

RegisterNUICallback('library', function(data, cb)
    if not opened or not opened.canControl or type(data) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false }) end

    local result = lib.callback.await('xex_tv:library', false, TV.descriptor(opened.tv), {
        query = type(data.query) == 'string' and data.query:sub(1, 60) or nil,
        genre = type(data.genre) == 'string' and data.genre or nil,
        page = tonumber(data.page) or 1,
    })
    if type(result) ~= 'table' then return cb({ ok = false, message = locale('library_failed') }) end
    if not result.ok then result.message = locale(result.message or 'library_failed') end
    cb(result)
end)

-- The guide asks again when it opens: what each channel airs changes over time.
RegisterNUICallback('channels', function(_, cb)
    if not opened then return cb({}) end
    local info = lib.callback.await('xex_tv:inspect', false, TV.descriptor(opened.tv))
    cb({ channels = type(info) == 'table' and info.ok and info.channels or nil })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('mute', function(_, cb)
    TV.localMute = not TV.localMute
    cb({ localMute = TV.localMute })
end)

RegisterNUICallback('close', function(_, cb)
    closeRemote()
    cb(1)
end)

AddEventHandler('onResourceStop', function(name)
    if name == GetCurrentResourceName() and opened then closeRemote() end
end)

exports('open', function() TV.openRemote(TV.nearest()) end)

-- Share codes, read and written: base64url, and inflate for "WDS1." codes (what a page's
-- CompressionStream('deflate') makes). Nothing here talks to whip_core; server/main.lua does.
--
--   WDS1.<base64url(zlib(JSON))>   what the screen makes
--   WDS0.<base64url(JSON)>         not deflated: what GetScenarioShareCode makes (no deflate in Lua)
--   ZX-XXXXXXX                     a short code: the hub (convar zext_share_hub) holds the long one

Codec = {}

Codec.MAX_BYTES = 512 * 1024   -- a scenario document's limit (whip_core's shipped-file limit)
local B64 = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789-_'
local B64V = {}
for i = 1, 64 do B64V[B64:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
B64V[('+'):byte()], B64V[('/'):byte()] = 62, 63

local function unb64url(s)
    local out, n, acc, bits = {}, 0, 0, 0
    for i = 1, #s do
        local v = B64V[s:byte(i)]
        if not v then return nil end
        acc, bits = (acc << 6) | v, bits + 6
        if bits >= 8 then
            bits = bits - 8
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = string.char((acc >> bits) & 255)
        end
        acc = acc & ((1 << bits) - 1)
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

local function b64url(s)
    local out, n = {}, 0
    for i = 1, #s, 3 do
        local a, b, c = s:byte(i, i + 2)
        local v = (a << 16) | ((b or 0) << 8) | (c or 0)
        local take = c and 4 or (b and 3 or 2)
        for k = 1, take do
            local d = (v >> (18 - 6 * (k - 1))) & 63
            n = n + 1
            out[n] = B64:sub(d + 1, d + 1)
        end
    end
    return table.concat(out)
end

-- Inflate (RFC 1950/1951), written for this: a page's CompressionStream('deflate') output back into text.
-- Never past maxOut bytes, so a small code cannot unpack into a huge one.
local LBASE = { 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 13, 15, 17, 19, 23, 27, 31, 35, 43, 51, 59, 67, 83, 99, 115, 131, 163, 195, 227, 258 }
