-- Server: screens, their clock and every player action.

local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()
local screens = {}
local locations = {}
local modelLookup = {}
local lastActionAt = {}
local lastReportAt = {}
local lastLibraryAt = {}
local actionCooldown = 750 -- ms between actions per player
local revisionCounter = 0

local function normalizeHash(hash)
    hash = tonumber(hash)
    if not hash then return nil end
    if hash < 0 then return hash + 4294967296 end
    return hash
end

for _, definition in ipairs(Config.Models) do
    modelLookup[normalizeHash(definition.hash or joaat(definition.model))] = definition
end

local function definitionFor(model)
    return modelLookup[normalizeHash(model)]
end

local function distance(a, b)
    local dx, dy, dz = a.x - b.x, a.y - b.y, a.z - b.z
    return math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
end

local function roundCoordinate(value)
    local scaled = value * 100
    return scaled >= 0 and math.floor(scaled + 0.5) or math.ceil(scaled - 0.5)
end

local function makeScreenId(bucket, model, coords)
    return ('%d:%u:%d:%d:%d'):format(bucket, normalizeHash(model),
        roundCoordinate(coords.x), roundCoordinate(coords.y), roundCoordinate(coords.z))
end

local function isFiniteNumber(value)
    return type(value) == 'number' and value == value and value > -10000.0 and value < 10000.0
end

local function clamp(value, min, max)
    return math.max(min, math.min(max, value))
end

local function nextRevision()
    revisionCounter = revisionCounter + 1
    return revisionCounter
end

local function playerLabel(src)
    return GetPlayerName(src) or ('ID %d'):format(src)
end

-- FIXED SCREENS ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

for index, location in ipairs(Config.Locations) do
    local model = normalizeHash(location.hash or joaat(location.model))
    local definition = definitionFor(model)
    if not definition then
        print(('^3[%s] Config.Locations[%d]: model %s is not in Config.Models, skipped.^7'):format(
            resourceName, index, tostring(location.model or location.hash)))
    else
        local coords = { x = location.coords.x, y = location.coords.y, z = location.coords.z }
        local bucket = tonumber(location.bucket) or 0
        locations[#locations + 1] = {
            id = makeScreenId(bucket, model, coords),
            bucket = bucket,
            model = model,
            coords = coords,
            definition = definition,
            config = location,
        }
    end
end

local function locationAt(bucket, model, coords)
    model = normalizeHash(model)
    for _, location in ipairs(locations) do
        if location.bucket == bucket and location.model == model and distance(location.coords, coords) <= 0.75 then
            return location
        end
    end
end

-- VALIDATION -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function validateDescriptor(src, descriptor)
    if type(descriptor) ~= 'table' or type(descriptor.coords) ~= 'table' then return nil, 'no_tv' end

    local model = normalizeHash(descriptor.model)
    local definition = model and definitionFor(model)
    if not definition then return nil, 'no_tv' end

    local coords = {
        x = tonumber(descriptor.coords.x),
        y = tonumber(descriptor.coords.y),
        z = tonumber(descriptor.coords.z),
    }
    if not isFiniteNumber(coords.x) or not isFiniteNumber(coords.y) or not isFiniteNumber(coords.z) then
        return nil, 'no_tv'
    end

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    if ped == 0 or not DoesEntityExist(ped) then return nil, 'too_far' end

    -- Big screens (cinemas, billboards) can be controlled from further away.
    local maxDistance = math.max(Config.Interaction.controlDistance, math.min(definition.drawDistance, 25.0)) + 5.0
    if #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(coords.x, coords.y, coords.z)) > maxDistance then
        return nil, 'too_far'
    end

    local bucket = GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src)
    local location = locationAt(bucket, model, coords)
    if location then return location end

    return {
        id = makeScreenId(bucket, model, coords),
        bucket = bucket,
        model = model,
        coords = coords,
        definition = definition,
    }
end

local function canControl(src, location)
    local perms = Config.Permissions
    if perms.adminAce and IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(src), perms.adminAce) then return true end
    if perms.ace and not IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(src), perms.ace) then return false end

    local lock = location and location.config and location.config.locked
    if not lock then return true end
    if lock.ace and IsPlayerAceAllowed(tostring(src), lock.ace) then return true end

    if lock.jobs then
        local job, grade = Bridge.GetJob(src)
        local minGrade = job and lock.jobs[job]
        if minGrade and (grade or 0) >= minGrade then return true end
    end
    return false
end

local function isRateLimited(src)
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - (lastActionAt[src] or 0) < actionCooldown then return true end
    lastActionAt[src] = now
    return false
end

-- STATE ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function currentPlaybackTime(screen)
    local current = screen.offset or 0
    if screen.playing then current = current + math.max(0, os.time() - screen.startedAt) end
    if screen.duration then current = math.min(current, screen.duration) end
    return current
end

local function serialiseScreen(screen)
    local queue = {}
    for i, item in ipairs(screen.queue) do
        queue[i] = { kind = item.kind, label = item.title or item.label }
    end

    return {
        id = screen.id,
        bucket = screen.bucket,
        model = screen.model,
        coords = screen.coords,
        media = screen.media,
        mediaToken = screen.mediaToken,
        -- A channel is live: everyone follows its clock, nobody seeks it.
        seekable = not screen.channel and Media.isSeekable(screen.media, screen.duration),
        live = screen.media ~= nil and (screen.media.live == true or screen.channel ~= nil and screen.duration == nil),
        channel = screen.channel,
        channelLabel = screen.channelLabel,
        channelNumber = screen.channelNumber,
        playing = screen.playing,
        currentTime = currentPlaybackTime(screen),
        duration = screen.duration,
        title = screen.title,
        volume = screen.volume,
        loop = screen.loop,
        queue = queue,
        label = screen.label,
        locked = screen.locked,
        revision = screen.revision,
        updatedBy = screen.updatedBy,
    }
end

local function forPlayersInBucket(bucket, callback)
    for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
        local numericId = tonumber(playerId)
        if numericId and GetPlayerRoutingBucket(numericId) == bucket then callback(numericId) end
    end
end

local function broadcastScreen(screen)
    local payload = serialiseScreen(screen)
    forPlayersInBucket(screen.bucket, function(playerId)
        TriggerClientEvent('xex_tv:syncOne', playerId, payload)
    end)
end

local function removeScreen(screen)
    screens[screen.id] = nil
    forPlayersInBucket(screen.bucket, function(playerId)
        TriggerClientEvent('xex_tv:removeOne', playerId, screen.id)
    end)
end

local function createScreen(base)
    local config = base.config
    return {
        id = base.id,
        bucket = base.bucket,
        model = base.model,
        coords = base.coords,
        label = config and config.label or nil,
        locked = config and config.locked ~= nil or false,
        loop = config and config.loop == true or false,
        volume = config and tonumber(config.volume) or Config.Playback.defaultVolume,
        queue = {},
    }
end

local function startMedia(screen, media, offset)
    screen.channel, screen.channelLabel, screen.channelNumber = nil, nil, nil
    screen.media = media
    screen.mediaToken = nextRevision()
    screen.playing = true
    screen.startedAt = os.time()
    screen.offset = offset or 0
    -- Known up front for the library and checked YouTube links; otherwise reported by a player.
    screen.duration = media.duration
    screen.title = media.title
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
end

-- Next item in the queue, the same one again (loop) or off.
local function advance(screen, actor)
    local nextMedia = table.remove(screen.queue, 1)
    if nextMedia then
        startMedia(screen, nextMedia)
    elseif screen.loop and screen.media then
        screen.offset, screen.startedAt, screen.playing = 0, os.time(), true
        screen.revision = nextRevision()
    else
        removeScreen(screen)
        return false
    end

    screen.updatedBy = actor
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return true
end

-- CHANNELS ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- The screen mirrors the channel: same media, token and clock as every other screen on it.
local function applyChannel(screen, channel)
    screen.channel = channel.id
    screen.channelLabel = channel.label
    screen.channelNumber = channel.number
    screen.media = channel.media
    screen.mediaToken = channel.mediaToken
    screen.playing = true
    screen.startedAt = channel.startedAt or os.time()
    screen.offset = 0
    screen.duration = channel.duration
    screen.title = channel.title
    screen.queue = {}
    screen.loop = false
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
end

Channels.onChange(function(channel)
    for _, screen in pairs(screens) do
        if screen.channel == channel.id then
            applyChannel(screen, channel)
            broadcastScreen(screen)
        end
    end
end)

-- 'channel:<id>' in autoplay, exports and the remote.
local function channelFromSource(source)
    local id = type(source) == 'string' and source:match('^channel:([%w_%-]+)$')
    return id and Channels.get(id) or nil
end

local function sendState(src, bucket)
    local payload = {}
    for id, screen in pairs(screens) do
        if screen.bucket == bucket then payload[id] = serialiseScreen(screen) end
    end
    TriggerClientEvent('xex_tv:syncAll', src, payload, bucket)
end

local playerBuckets = {}

-- The playback clock lives here, so queues and loops keep going with nobody watching.
-- It also notices routing bucket changes (instanced houses...) and sends that bucket's screens at once.
CreateThread(function()
    while true do
        Wait(1000)
        local now = os.time()
        for _, screen in pairs(screens) do
            if not screen.channel and screen.playing and screen.duration and currentPlaybackTime(screen) >= screen.duration then
                advance(screen, 'auto')
            elseif not screen.playing and screen.pausedAt and now - screen.pausedAt > 3600 then
                -- Paused and forgotten for an hour: turn it off.
                removeScreen(screen)
            end
        end

        for _, playerId in ipairs(GetPlayers()) do
            local src = tonumber(playerId)
            local bucket = src and GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src)
            if bucket and playerBuckets[src] ~= nil and playerBuckets[src] ~= bucket then
                sendState(src, bucket)
            end
            if src then playerBuckets[src] = bucket end
        end
    end
end)

-- ACTIONS ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local function response(ok, key, screen)
    return { ok = ok, message = key, screen = screen and serialiseScreen(screen) or nil }
end

local function parseVolume(value, fallback)
    local volume = tonumber(value)
    if not volume then return fallback end
    return clamp(math.floor(volume + 0.5), 0, 100)
end

local actions = {}

-- Parses and checks the link a player sent. This waits for YouTube, Vimeo, archive.org or the stream,
-- so callers read the screen again afterwards: someone else may have changed it meanwhile.
local function requestedMedia(value)
    local request = type(value) == 'table' and value or {}
    local media, err = Media.fromInput(request.source)
    return media, err or 'invalid_source'
end

function actions.tune(src, target, _, value)
    local request = type(value) == 'table' and value or {}
    local channel = Channels.get(request.channel)
    if not channel then return response(false, 'error') end

    local screen = screens[target.id] or createScreen(target)
    screen.volume = parseVolume(request.volume, screen.volume)
    applyChannel(screen, channel)
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    screens[screen.id] = screen
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'tuned', screen)
end

function actions.play(src, target, _, value)
    local request = type(value) == 'table' and value or {}
    local channel = channelFromSource(request.source)
    if channel then
        return actions.tune(src, target, nil, { channel = channel.id, volume = request.volume })
    end

    local media, err = requestedMedia(request)
    if not media then return response(false, err) end

    local screen = screens[target.id] or createScreen(target)
    screen.volume = parseVolume(request.volume, screen.volume)
    startMedia(screen, media)
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    screens[screen.id] = screen
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'started', screen)
end

function actions.queue(src, target, screen, value)
    if not Config.Queue.enabled then return response(false, 'queue_disabled') end
    if not screen then return actions.play(src, target, screen, value) end
    if #screen.queue >= Config.Queue.maxItems then return response(false, 'queue_full') end

    local media, err = requestedMedia(value)
    if not media then return response(false, err) end

    screen = screens[target.id]
    if not screen then return actions.play(src, target, nil, value) end
    if screen.channel then return response(false, 'channel_live', screen) end
    if #screen.queue >= Config.Queue.maxItems then return response(false, 'queue_full') end

    screen.queue[#screen.queue + 1] = media
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'queued', screen)
end

function actions.togglePause(src, _, screen)
    if screen.playing then
        screen.offset = currentPlaybackTime(screen)
        screen.playing = false
        screen.pausedAt = os.time()
    else
        screen.playing = true
        screen.startedAt = os.time()
    end
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, screen.playing and 'resumed' or 'paused', screen)
end

function actions.volume(src, _, screen, value)
    local volume = parseVolume(value)
    if not volume then return response(false, 'error') end
    screen.volume = volume
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'volume', screen)
end

function actions.seek(src, _, screen, value)
    if not Media.isSeekable(screen.media, screen.duration) then return response(false, 'not_seekable') end
    local seconds = tonumber(value)
    if not seconds or seconds ~= seconds then return response(false, 'error') end

    screen.offset = clamp(math.floor(seconds), 0, screen.duration and math.max(0, screen.duration - 1) or 86400)
    screen.startedAt = os.time()
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'seeked', screen)
end

function actions.next(src, _, screen)
    if #screen.queue == 0 then return response(false, 'queue_empty', screen) end
    advance(screen, playerLabel(src))
    return response(true, 'skipped', screen)
end

function actions.loop(src, _, screen)
    screen.loop = not screen.loop
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    screen.updatedBy = playerLabel(src)
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, screen.loop and 'loop_on' or 'loop_off', screen)
end

function actions.unqueue(_, _, screen, value)
    local index = math.tointeger(tonumber(value))
    if not index or not screen.queue[index] then return response(false, 'error', screen) end
    table.remove(screen.queue, index)
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'unqueued', screen)
end

function actions.refresh(_, _, screen)
    screen.revision = nextRevision()
    broadcastScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'refreshed', screen)
end

function actions.stop(_, _, screen)
    removeScreen(screen)
    return response(true, 'stopped')
end

local needsNoScreen = { play = true, queue = true, tune = true }

-- Not possible on a live channel: change the channel or play something else instead.
local notOnChannel = { queue = true, togglePause = true, seek = true, next = true, loop = true, unqueue = true }

lib.callback.register('xex_tv:action', function(src, action, descriptor, value)
    local handler = type(action) == 'string' and actions[action]
    if not handler then return response(false, 'error') end
    if isRateLimited(src) then return response(false, 'rate_limited') end

    local target, err = validateDescriptor(src, descriptor)
    if not target then return response(false, err) end
    if not canControl(src, target) then return response(false, 'no_permission') end

    local screen = screens[target.id]
    if not screen and not needsNoScreen[action] then return response(false, 'no_active_media') end
    if screen and screen.channel and notOnChannel[action] then return response(false, 'channel_live', screen) end
    return handler(src, target, screen, value)
end)

-- What the remote needs on open: can this player control it, and what is playing.
lib.callback.register('xex_tv:inspect', function(src, descriptor)
    local target, err = validateDescriptor(src, descriptor)
    if not target then return { ok = false, message = err } end
    local screen = screens[target.id]
    return {
        ok = true,
        canControl = canControl(src, target),
        label = target.config and target.config.label or nil,
        screen = screen and serialiseScreen(screen) or nil,
        channels = Channels.list(),
    }
end)

-- Library search for the remote. Same checks as the remote: near a screen this player can control.
lib.callback.register('xex_tv:library', function(src, descriptor, request)
    if not (Config.Library and Config.Library.enabled) then return { ok = false, message = 'error' } end

    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - (lastLibraryAt[src] or 0) < 800 then return { ok = false, message = 'rate_limited' } end
    lastLibraryAt[src] = now

    local target, err = validateDescriptor(src, descriptor)
    if not target then return { ok = false, message = err } end
    if not canControl(src, target) then return { ok = false, message = 'no_permission' } end

    return Library.search(request)
end)

local lastStateAt = {}

RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:requestState', function()
    local src = source
    local now = GetGameTimer()
    if now - (lastStateAt[src] or -5000) < 5000 then return end
    lastStateAt[src] = now

    local bucket = GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src)
    playerBuckets[src] = bucket
    sendState(src, bucket)
end)

-- A report about a screen from a player near it, in its bucket, about the media it is playing now.
local function nearScreen(src, id, token, kind)
    local screen = type(id) == 'string' and screens[id]
    if not screen or screen.mediaToken ~= token then return nil end
    if GetPlayerRoutingBucket(src) ~= screen.bucket then return nil end

    local now, key = GetGameTimer(), src .. kind
    if now - (lastReportAt[key] or 0) < 500 then return nil end
    lastReportAt[key] = now

    local ped = GetPlayerPed(src)
    local definition = definitionFor(screen.model)
    if ped == 0 or not definition then return nil end
    if #(GetEntityCoords(ped) - vector3(screen.coords.x, screen.coords.y, screen.coords.z)) > definition.drawDistance + 10.0 then
        return nil
    end
    return screen
end

-- A player who can control the screen is trusted. Otherwise two players have to report the same thing,
-- so a single client can't cut a video short, rename it or skip a channel. Returns the agreed values.
local function agreed(src, screen, token, kind, values)
    if canControl(src, locationAt(screen.bucket, screen.model, screen.coords)) then return values end

    if screen.reportToken ~= token then screen.reportToken, screen.reports = token, {} end
    local reports = screen.reports[kind] or {}
    screen.reports[kind] = reports

    local result = {}
    for other, report in pairs(reports) do
        if other ~= src then
            for key, value in pairs(values) do
                local theirs = report[key]
                if type(value) == 'number' and type(theirs) == 'number' then
                    if math.abs(theirs - value) <= 2 then result[key] = value end
                elseif theirs ~= nil and theirs == value then
                    result[key] = value
                end
            end
        end
    end
    reports[src] = values
    return result
end

-- Players watching a screen report its duration, title and whether it is live, once per media, for what
-- the server couldn't read up front (YouTube durations, video files, HLS streams). The duration drives
-- the queue.
RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:mediaInfo', function(id, token, info)
    local src = source
    if type(info) ~= 'table' then return end
    local screen = nearScreen(src, id, token, ':info')
    if not screen then return end

    local duration = tonumber(info.duration)
    duration = duration and math.floor(duration)
    -- A video can't be shorter than what has already played.
    if duration and (duration < 1 or duration > 86400 or duration + 5 < currentPlaybackTime(screen)) then duration = nil end

    local values = agreed(src, screen, token, 'info', {
        duration = duration,
        title = Media.sanitiseTitle(info.title),
        live = info.live == true or nil,
    })
    local live = values.live == true
    duration = not live and values.duration or nil
    local title = values.title

    -- On a channel the report goes to the channel, which updates every screen tuned to it.
    if screen.channel then
        Channels.reportMedia(screen.channel, token, duration, title)
        return
    end

    local changed = false
    if live and not screen.media.live then
        screen.media.live = true
        screen.duration = nil
        changed = true
    elseif not screen.duration and Media.hasClock(screen.media) and duration then
        screen.duration = duration
        changed = true
    end

    title = not screen.title and title
    if title then
        screen.title = title
        changed = true
    end

    if changed then
        screen.revision = nextRevision()
        broadcastScreen(screen)
    end
end)

-- Players can't play what a channel is airing (a stream that went down, a video blocked in the game
-- browser): the channel moves on to its next source. Other screens just show the error.
RegisterNetEvent('xex_tv:mediaError', function(id, token, code)
    local src = source
    local screen = nearScreen(src, id, token, ':error')
    if not screen or not screen.channel then return end

    code = type(code) == 'string' and code:sub(1, 40) or 'UNKNOWN'
    if agreed(src, screen, token, 'error', { failed = true }).failed then
        Channels.skip(screen.channel, token, code)
    end
end)

AddEventHandler('playerDropped', function()
    playerBuckets[source] = nil
    lastActionAt[source] = nil
    lastReportAt[source .. ':info'], lastReportAt[source .. ':error'] = nil, nil
    lastLibraryAt[source] = nil
    lastStateAt[source] = nil
end)

-- AUTOPLAY ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

CreateThread(function()
    for _, location in ipairs(locations) do
        local autoplay = location.config.autoplay
        local channel = autoplay and channelFromSource(autoplay)
        if channel then
            local screen = createScreen(location)
            applyChannel(screen, channel)
            screen.updatedBy = 'autoplay'
            screens[screen.id] = screen
            broadcastScreen(screen)
        elseif autoplay then
            -- Each screen checks its link on its own. A service that is down (archive.org, a broadcaster)
            -- is tried again a bit later each time, so the screen comes on when it is back.
            CreateThread(function()
                local delays = { 60, 120, 240, 480, 600 }
                local attempt = 0
                while true do
                    local media, err, reason, transient = Media.fromInput(autoplay, true)
                    if media then
                        local screen = createScreen(location)
                        startMedia(screen, media)
                        screen.updatedBy = 'autoplay'
                        screens[screen.id] = screen
                        -- Checking the link takes a moment: players already in (resource restart) get it now.
                        broadcastScreen(screen)
                        return
                    end
                    if not transient then
                        print(('^3[%s] Autoplay source of "%s" was rejected (%s%s). Check the link and Config.Sources.^7'):format(
                            resourceName, tostring(location.config.label or location.id), tostring(err),
                            reason and ', ' .. reason or ''))
                        return
                    end
                    attempt = attempt + 1
                    local delay = delays[math.min(attempt, #delays)]
                    if Config.Debug and attempt == 1 then
                        print(('^3[%s] Autoplay source of "%s" can\'t be checked right now (%s). Retrying in %d s.^7'):format(
                            resourceName, tostring(location.config.label or location.id), reason or tostring(err), delay))
                    end
                    Wait(delay * 1000)
                end
            end)
        end
    end
end)

-- EXPORTS ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- exports.xex_tv:playAtCoords(vec3(x, y, z), `prop_tv_flat_01`, 'https://youtu.be/...', { volume, offset, bucket, loop })
-- Returns the screen id at once; it starts playing as soon as the link is checked (usually under a second).
exports('playAtCoords', function(coords, model, input, options)
    options = type(options) == 'table' and options or {}
    if not definitionFor(model) or type(coords) ~= 'vector3' and type(coords) ~= 'table' then return false end
    local channel = channelFromSource(input)
    if not channel and not Media.parse(input, true) then return false end

    local bucket = tonumber(options.bucket) or 0
    local plain = { x = coords.x + 0.0, y = coords.y + 0.0, z = coords.z + 0.0 }
    local target = locationAt(bucket, model, plain) or {
        id = makeScreenId(bucket, model, plain),
        bucket = bucket,
        model = normalizeHash(model),
        coords = plain,
    }

    local invoker = GetInvokingResource() or 'export'
    if channel then
        local screen = screens[target.id] or createScreen(target)
        screen.volume = parseVolume(options.volume, screen.volume)
        applyChannel(screen, channel)
        screen.updatedBy = invoker
        screens[screen.id] = screen
        broadcastScreen(screen)
        return target.id
    end

    CreateThread(function()
        local media, err = Media.fromInput(input, true)
        if not media then
            print(('^3[%s] playAtCoords from %s: link rejected (%s).^7'):format(resourceName, invoker, tostring(err)))
            return
        end
        local screen = screens[target.id] or createScreen(target)
        screen.volume = parseVolume(options.volume, screen.volume)
        if options.loop ~= nil then screen.loop = options.loop == true end
        startMedia(screen, media, math.max(0, tonumber(options.offset) or 0))
        screen.updatedBy = invoker
        screens[screen.id] = screen
        broadcastScreen(screen)
    end)
    return target.id
end)

-- Returns true if the link looks valid; it joins the queue once checked.
exports('queue', function(screenId, input)
    if not screens[screenId] or screens[screenId].channel or not Media.parse(input, true) then return false end
    CreateThread(function()
        local media = Media.fromInput(input, true)
        local screen = screens[screenId]
        if not media or not screen or screen.channel or #screen.queue >= Config.Queue.maxItems then return end
        screen.queue[#screen.queue + 1] = media
        screen.revision = nextRevision()
        broadcastScreen(screen)
    end)
    return true
end)

exports('stop', function(screenId)
    local screen = screens[screenId]
    if not screen then return false end
    removeScreen(screen)
    return true
end)

exports('getScreen', function(screenId)
    local screen = screens[screenId]
    return screen and serialiseScreen(screen) or nil
end)

-- VERSION CHECK -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

-- '1.10.0' is newer than '1.9.2'.
local function newer(latest, current)
    local a, b = {}, {}
    for n in tostring(latest):gmatch('%d+') do a[#a + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    for n in tostring(current):gmatch('%d+') do b[#b + 1] = tonumber(n) end
    for i = 1, math.max(#a, #b) do
        if (a[i] or 0) ~= (b[i] or 0) then return (a[i] or 0) > (b[i] or 0) end
    end
    return false
end

if Config.CheckForUpdates then
    CreateThread(function()
        Wait(5000)
        local current = GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'version', 0)
        PerformHttpRequest('https://xexstudio.com/api/version/xex_tv?v=' .. current, function(status, body)
            if status ~= 200 or not body then return end
            local ok, data = pcall(json.decode, body)
            if not ok or not data or not data.version then return end
            if newer(data.version, current) then
                print(('^3[%s] Update available: %s -> %s (https://keymaster.fivem.net)^7'):format(resourceName, current, data.version))
            else
                print(('^2[%s] Up to date (%s).^7'):format(resourceName, current))
            end
        end, 'GET')
    end)
end

-- Turns what a player pastes (or what the config lists) into something every player can load.
--
-- Kinds: youtube, vimeo, archive (library films), direct (video files) and hls (live TV streams).
-- 'ytlive' is only a parsed step: whatever a YouTube channel is airing live now, resolved into a youtube media.

Media = {}

local resourceName = GetCurrentResourceName()

local function trim(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    value = value:gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if value == '' or #value > 2048 then return nil end
    return value
end

local function libraryOn()
    return Config.Library ~= nil and Config.Library.enabled == true
end

local function sourceOn(name)
    return Config.Sources ~= nil and Config.Sources[name] == true
end

-- archive.org identifiers: letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.
local function parseArchive(input)
    local id = input:match('archive%.org/details/([%w%._%-]+)')
        or input:match('archive%.org/download/([%w%._%-]+)')
        or input:match('^archive:([%w%._%-]+)$')
    if id and #id >= 3 and #id <= 100 then
        return { kind = 'archive', id = id, label = id }
    end
end

-- A YouTube channel by handle (@name) or id (UC...).
local function channelRef(value)
    if type(value) ~= 'string' then return nil end
    local handle = value:match('^(@[%w%._%-]+)$')
    if handle and #handle >= 4 and #handle <= 101 then return handle end
    local id = value:match('^(UC[%w_%-]+)$')
    if id and #id == 24 then return id end
end

-- 'ytlive:@handle', 'ytlive:UC...', youtube.com/@handle/live or youtube.com/channel/UC.../live.
local function parseYouTubeLive(input)
    local ref = channelRef(input:match('^[Yy][Tt][Ll][Ii][Vv][Ee]:(.+)$'))
        or channelRef(input:match('youtube%.com/(@[%w%._%-]+)/live/?$'))
        or channelRef(input:match('youtube%.com/(@[%w%._%-]+)/live[%?#]'))
        or channelRef(input:match('youtube%.com/channel/(UC[%w_%-]+)/live/?$'))
        or channelRef(input:match('youtube%.com/channel/(UC[%w_%-]+)/live[%?#]'))
    if ref then
        return { kind = 'ytlive', channel = ref, label = ref }
    end
end

local function parseYouTube(input, trusted)
    local live = parseYouTubeLive(input)
    if live then return live end

    local id = input:match('[?&]v=([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('youtu%.be/([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('youtube%.com/embed/([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('youtube%-nocookie%.com/embed/([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('youtube%.com/shorts/([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('youtube%.com/live/([%w_-]+)')
        or input:match('^youtube:([%w_-]+)$')

    if not id and input:match('^[%w_-]+$') and #input >= 6 and #input <= 20 then
        id = input
    end

    if id and #id >= 6 and #id <= 20 then
        -- A config source on youtube.com/live/<id> is a live stream: screens report it once it has ended.
        local liveId = trusted and input:find('youtube%.com/live/') and true or nil
        return { kind = 'youtube', id = id, label = id, live = liveId }
    end
end

-- vimeo.com/<id>, vimeo.com/<id>/<hash> (unlisted), player.vimeo.com/video/<id>?h=<hash>, vimeo:<id>[/<hash>].
local function parseVimeo(input)
    local id, hash = input:match('^[Vv][Ii][Mm][Ee][Oo]:(%d+)/?(%x*)$')
    if not id then
        id = input:match('player%.vimeo%.com/video/(%d+)')
        if id then
            hash = input:match('[?&]h=(%x+)')
        else
            id, hash = input:match('vimeo%.com/(%d+)/?(%x*)')
        end
    end

    if id and #id >= 3 and #id <= 12 then
        hash = hash and #hash >= 6 and #hash <= 20 and hash or nil
        return { kind = 'vimeo', id = id, hash = hash, label = id }
    end
end

-- Host of an http(s) link, or nil. Links with backslashes, credentials or spaces are refused:
-- browsers read `https://a.com\.b.com` as a.com, which would slip past a suffix check.
local function hostOf(input)
    if input:find('[\\%s]') then return nil end
    if (input:match('^%a+://([^/%?#]*)') or ''):find('@', 1, true) then return nil end
    local host, rest = input:lower():match('^https?://([%w%.%-]+)(.*)$')
    if not host or (rest ~= '' and not rest:match('^[:/%?#]')) then return nil end
    return host
end

local function hostIs(host, domain)
    return host == domain or host:sub(-(#domain + 1)) == '.' .. domain
end

local function allowedHost(host)
    for _, allowed in ipairs(Config.AllowedMediaHosts) do
        if hostIs(host, allowed:lower()) then return true end
    end
    return false
end

-- Video files and HLS streams. Config sources (channels, fixed screens, exports) are trusted; links
-- players paste only play from Config.AllowedMediaHosts, because every player connects to that host.
local function parseStream(input, host, trusted, forceHls)
    if input:lower():sub(1, 8) ~= 'https://' then return nil end
    if not trusted and not allowedHost(host) then return nil end

    local path = input:match('^https://[^/%?#]+([^%?#]*)') or ''
    if forceHls or path:lower():match('%.m3u8$') then
        return { kind = 'hls', url = input, label = host }
    end
    local file = path:match('([^/]+)$') or host
    return { kind = 'direct', url = input, label = file:sub(1, 80) }
end

-- Returns a parsed source or nil. `trusted` is for sources from the config and from exports.
function Media.parse(raw, trusted)
    local input = trim(raw)
    if not input then return nil end
    local lower = input:lower()

    -- 'hls:https://...' marks a live stream whose URL doesn't end in .m3u8.
    local forceHls = false
    if lower:sub(1, 4) == 'hls:' then
        input, lower, forceHls = input:sub(5), lower:sub(5), true
        if not lower:match('^https://') then return nil end
    end

    if lower:match('^https?://') then
        local host = hostOf(input)
        if not host then return nil end
        if not forceHls then
            if hostIs(host, 'archive.org') then return libraryOn() and parseArchive(input) or nil end
            if hostIs(host, 'youtube.com') or hostIs(host, 'youtu.be') or hostIs(host, 'youtube-nocookie.com') then
                return sourceOn('youtube') and parseYouTube(input, trusted) or nil
            end
            if hostIs(host, 'vimeo.com') then
                return sourceOn('vimeo') and parseVimeo(input) or nil
            end
        end
        return parseStream(input, host, trusted, forceHls)
    end

    if lower:sub(1, 8) == 'archive:' then return libraryOn() and parseArchive(input) or nil end
    if lower:sub(1, 6) == 'vimeo:' then return sourceOn('vimeo') and parseVimeo(input) or nil end
    if lower:sub(1, 7) == 'ytlive:' then return sourceOn('youtube') and parseYouTubeLive(input) or nil end
    if sourceOn('youtube') then return parseYouTube(input) end
end

-- Sources whose time can be read and set. A live stream never can; an HLS stream only once a player
-- found it is a recording with a length.
function Media.isSeekable(media, duration)
    if not media or media.live then return false end
    if media.kind == 'hls' then return duration ~= nil end
    return media.kind == 'youtube' or media.kind == 'vimeo' or media.kind == 'direct' or media.kind == 'archive'
end

-- Sources whose length a player may report. Live streams have none.
function Media.hasClock(media)
    if not media or media.live then return false end
    return media.kind == 'youtube' or media.kind == 'vimeo' or media.kind == 'direct'
        or media.kind == 'archive' or media.kind == 'hls'
end

-- The service a source depends on, for sources that share one: when it is down, its other sources are
-- down too, so a channel doesn't ask it once per source. archive.org is not listed: the library holds
-- that back itself and still serves the films it has stored.
function Media.service(raw)
    local lower = type(raw) == 'string' and raw:lower() or ''
    if lower:sub(1, 7) == 'ytlive:' then return 'youtube' end
end

-- HTTP --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local userAgent = ('xex_tv/%s (FiveM)'):format(GetResourceMetadata(resourceName, 'version', 0) or '?')

-- An answer that says the service, not the source, has a problem: no answer, rate limiting, server errors.
function Media.isTransient(status)
    return status == 0 or status == 408 or status == 429 or status >= 500
end
local browserAgent = 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0 Safari/537.36'

function Media.urlEncode(value)
    return (tostring(value):gsub('[^%w%-_%.~]', function(char) return ('%%%02X'):format(char:byte()) end))
end

-- GET from a server thread. Returns the status (0 on timeout), the body and the response headers.
function Media.httpGet(url, headers)
    local p = promise.new()
    local settled = false

    PerformHttpRequest(url, function(status, body, responseHeaders)
        if settled then return end
        settled = true
        p:resolve({ status = status, body = body, headers = responseHeaders })
    end, 'GET', '', headers or { ['User-Agent'] = userAgent })

    SetTimeout(8000, function()
        if settled then return end
        settled = true
        p:resolve({ status = 0 })
    end)

    local result = Citizen.Await(p)
    return result.status, result.body, type(result.headers) == 'table' and result.headers or {}
end

-- GET a JSON document from a server thread. Returns the status (0 on timeout) and the decoded body.
function Media.httpJson(url)
    local status, body = Media.httpGet(url, { ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['User-Agent'] = userAgent })
    local data
    if status == 200 and body then
        local ok, decoded = pcall(json.decode, body)
        if ok and type(decoded) == 'table' then data = decoded end
    end
    return status, data
end

function Media.sanitiseTitle(title)
    if type(title) ~= 'string' or not utf8.len(title) then return nil end
    title = title:gsub('%c', ' '):gsub('^%s+', ''):gsub('%s+$', '')
    if title == '' then return nil end
    local cut = utf8.offset(title, 121)
    return cut and title:sub(1, cut - 1) or title
end

-- Answers kept for a while, emptied when they pile up.
local function newCache(limit)
    local entries, size = {}, 0
    return {
        get = function(key)
            local entry = entries[key]
            if entry and entry.expires >= os.time() then return entry end
        end,
        set = function(key, entry, ttl)
            if size > limit then entries, size = {}, 0 end
            entry.expires = os.time() + ttl
            entries[key] = entry
            size = size + 1
        end,
    }
end

-- RESOLVE: YOUTUBE --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local youtubeCache = newCache(500)

-- Asks YouTube (oEmbed) whether the video exists and can be embedded, and gets its title.
-- Videos limited to some domains still pass: only the game browser can tell, and the screen shows why.
local function resolveYouTube(media)
    local cached = youtubeCache.get(media.id)
    if not cached then
        local url = 'https://www.youtube.com/oembed?format=json&url='
            .. Media.urlEncode('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=' .. media.id)
        local status, data = Media.httpJson(url)

        if status == 401 then
            cached = { error = 'not_embeddable' }
        elseif status == 400 or status == 403 or status == 404 then
            cached = { error = 'not_found' }
        else
            -- YouTube unreachable or rate limited: let the player try instead of blocking playback.
            cached = { title = data and Media.sanitiseTitle(data.title) }
        end
        youtubeCache.set(media.id, cached, status == 200 and 1800 or 300)
    end

    if cached.error then return nil, cached.error end
    return {
        kind = 'youtube',
        id = media.id,
        label = cached.title or media.id,
        title = cached.title,
        live = media.live or nil,
    }
end

local liveCache = newCache(200)

-- The video a channel is airing live now. Its /live page points to that video while it is on air,
-- and to the channel itself when it isn't.
local function resolveYouTubeLive(media)
    local cached = liveCache.get(media.channel)
    if not cached then
        local path = media.channel:sub(1, 1) == '@' and media.channel or 'channel/' .. media.channel
        local status, body = Media.httpGet('https://www.youtube.com/' .. path .. '/live', {
            ['User-Agent'] = browserAgent,
            ['Accept-Language'] = 'en',
            -- Skips the cookie consent page YouTube shows to servers in the EU.
            ['Cookie'] = 'SOCS=CAI',
        })

        if status == 200 and type(body) == 'string' then
            local id = body:match('<link rel="canonical" href="https://www%.youtube%.com/watch%?v=([%w_-]+)"')
            -- A scheduled stream also has a watch page: only take one that is on air.
            local onAir = body:find('"isLiveNow":true', 1, true)
                or body:find('"isLive":true', 1, true) and not body:find('"isUpcoming":true', 1, true)
            if id and onAir then
                cached = { id = id }
            else
                cached = { error = 'not_live' }
            end
        elseif status == 404 then
            cached = { error = 'not_found' }
        else
            cached = { error = 'stream_failed', reason = ('HTTP %s'):format(tostring(status)), transient = Media.isTransient(status) }
        end
        liveCache.set(media.channel, cached, cached.id and 120 or cached.transient and 30 or 60)
    end

    if cached.error then return nil, cached.error, cached.reason, cached.transient end
    local resolved, err = resolveYouTube({ id = cached.id, live = true })
    if not resolved then return nil, err end
    return resolved
end

-- RESOLVE: VIMEO ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local vimeoCache = newCache(300)

-- Vimeo's oEmbed tells whether the video exists, its title and its length. Videos the owner limited to
-- some websites come back without a title: those can't play in the game.
local function resolveVimeo(media)
    local key = media.id .. '/' .. (media.hash or '')
    local cached = vimeoCache.get(key)
    if not cached then
        local page = 'https://vimeo.com/' .. media.id .. (media.hash and '/' .. media.hash or '')
        local status, data = Media.httpJson('https://vimeo.com/api/oembed.json?url=' .. Media.urlEncode(page))

        if status == 200 and data then
            local title = Media.sanitiseTitle(data.title)
            local duration = math.tointeger(tonumber(data.duration))
            if title then
                cached = { title = title, duration = duration and duration >= 1 and duration or nil }
            else
                cached = { error = 'not_embeddable' }
            end
        elseif status == 403 then
            cached = { error = 'not_embeddable' }
        elseif status == 404 then
            cached = { error = 'not_found' }
        else
            -- Vimeo unreachable: let the player try.
            cached = {}
        end
        vimeoCache.set(key, cached, status == 200 and 1800 or 300)
    end

    if cached.error then return nil, cached.error end
    return {
        kind = 'vimeo',
        id = media.id,
        hash = media.hash,
        label = cached.title or media.id,
        title = cached.title,
        duration = cached.duration,
    }
end

-- RESOLVE: HLS ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

local streamCache = newCache(300)

-- Where the screens load the player from. The stream has to allow that origin (CORS) or the browser
-- refuses to read it.
local function playerOrigin()
    local url = Config.Playback and Config.Playback.playerUrl
    local origin = type(url) == 'string' and url:match('^(https?://[^/%?#]+)')
    return origin or ('https://cfx-nui-%s'):format(resourceName)
end

local function header(headers, name)
    for key, value in pairs(headers) do
        if type(key) == 'string' and key:lower() == name then return value end
    end
end

-- Checks that the playlist answers, is an HLS playlist and lets the game browser read it.
local function resolveHls(media)
    local cached = streamCache.get(media.url)
    if not cached then
        local origin = playerOrigin()
        local status, body, headers = Media.httpGet(media.url, { ['User-Agent'] = browserAgent, ['Origin'] = origin })
        local allowed = header(headers, 'access-control-allow-origin')

        if status ~= 200 or type(body) ~= 'string' or body:sub(1, 7) ~= '#EXTM3U' then
            cached = { error = 'stream_failed', reason = ('HTTP %s'):format(tostring(status)), transient = Media.isTransient(status) }
        elseif allowed ~= '*' and allowed ~= origin then
            cached = { error = 'stream_failed', reason = 'the stream does not allow browser playback (CORS)' }
        else
            -- A media playlist without an end is live. A master playlist doesn't say: the player tells.
            local live = not body:find('#EXT-X-STREAM-INF', 1, true) and not body:find('#EXT-X-ENDLIST', 1, true)
            cached = { live = live }
        end
        streamCache.set(media.url, cached, cached.transient and 30 or cached.error and 60 or 300)
    end

    if cached.error then return nil, cached.error, cached.reason, cached.transient end
    return { kind = 'hls', url = media.url, label = media.label, live = cached.live or nil }
end

-- Turns a parsed source into something every player can load. Must run in a thread: it may ask YouTube,
-- Vimeo, archive.org or the stream first. Returns the media, or nil, a locale key, a reason for the console
-- and whether the failure is the service's (down, rate limiting, timeout) rather than the source's.
function Media.resolve(media, trusted)
    if not media then return nil, 'invalid_source' end
    if media.kind == 'youtube' then return resolveYouTube(media) end
    if media.kind == 'ytlive' then return resolveYouTubeLive(media) end
    if media.kind == 'vimeo' then return resolveVimeo(media) end
    if media.kind == 'archive' then return Library.resolve(media.id, trusted) end
    if media.kind == 'hls' then return resolveHls(media) end
    return media
end

function Media.fromInput(raw, trusted)
    return Media.resolve(Media.parse(raw, trusted), trusted)
end

-- sd-pocket-beat: the whole Lua side of the app.
--
-- What it does:
--   1. Waits until sd-phone has started, then registers the app.
--   2. Re-registers whenever sd-phone restarts (registrations live in the phone's
--      memory only, so a restart forgets them).
--   3. Adds /pocketbeat so staff can open it without hunting the home screen.
--
-- There is no server script and no database: the drum machine is a pure client-side
-- instrument, which is what makes it work on any framework.

-- Builds the value handed to addCustomApp as the `ui` field. A full http(s) URL (a
-- live dev server) passes through untouched; anything else becomes the resource-
-- relative form sd-phone rewrites into https://cfx-nui-<resource>/...
---@return string|nil
local function resolveUi()
    local resource = GetCurrentResourceName()
    local uiPage = GetResourceMetadata(resource, 'ui_page', 0)
    if not uiPage or uiPage == '' then return nil end
    if uiPage:find('^https?://') then
        return uiPage
    end
    return resource .. '/' .. uiPage
end

-- Registers (or re-registers) this resource's app with sd-phone. Safe to call more
-- than once; re-registering the same identifier just replaces the old entry.
local function register()
    local resource = GetCurrentResourceName()

    local ok, err = exports['sd-phone']:addCustomApp({
        identifier  = Config.Identifier,
        name        = Config.Name,
        description = Config.Description,
        developer   = Config.Developer,
        defaultApp  = Config.DefaultApp,
        ui          = resolveUi(),
        icon        = ('https://cfx-nui-%s/ui/icon.svg'):format(resource),
        images      = {
            ('https://cfx-nui-%s/ui/screenshot-1.png'):format(resource),
            ('https://cfx-nui-%s/ui/screenshot-2.png'):format(resource),
        },
        size        = Config.Size,
        price       = Config.Price,
        onOpen = function()
            print(('[%s] onOpen: player opened the drum machine'):format(Config.Identifier))
        end,
        onClose = function()
            print(('[%s] onClose: player closed the drum machine'):format(Config.Identifier))
        end,
    })

    if ok then
        print(('[%s] registered with sd-phone'):format(Config.Identifier))
    else
        print(('[%s] registration failed: %s'):format(Config.Identifier, err or 'unknown error'))
    end
end

-- Initial registration once sd-phone is up. The export can land a moment after the
-- resource reports "started", so wait one extra beat.
CreateThread(function()
    while GetResourceState('sd-phone') ~= 'started' do
        Wait(500)
    end
    Wait(1000)
    register()
end)

-- Re-register after a phone restart so the app comes back without rebooting this one.
AddEventHandler('onResourceStart', function(startedResource)
    if startedResource ~= 'sd-phone' then return end
    Wait(1000)
    register()
end)

-- Convenience command. Reads the version back from the manifest so the printout
-- never drifts from fxmanifest.lua.
if Config.Command then
    RegisterCommand(Config.Command, function()
        if GetResourceState('sd-phone') ~= 'started' then
            print(('[%s] sd-phone is not running'):format(Config.Identifier))
            return
        end
        exports['sd-phone']:openApp(Config.Identifier)
    end, false)
end

CreateThread(function()
    local version = GetResourceMetadata(GetCurrentResourceName(), 'version', 0)
    print(('[%s] v%s loaded — a drum machine with no server, no database and no audio files')
        :format(Config.Identifier, version or '?'))
end)

    SonoranCAD FiveM Integration

    Commands Module

    Provides /sonoran command for console control
]]

--[[ /sonoran
    debugmode - old caddebug toggle
    info - dump version info, configuration
    support - dump useful data for support staff
    verify - run hash checks to confirm all files are untampered
    plugin <name> - show info about a plugin (config)
    update - attempt to auto-update
]]

local function sanitizeForJson(value, seen)
    local valueType = type(value)
    if valueType == "nil" or valueType == "boolean" or valueType == "number" or valueType == "string" then
        return value
    end
    if valueType == "function" or valueType == "thread" or valueType == "userdata" then
        return ("<%s>"):format(valueType)
    end
    if valueType ~= "table" then
        return tostring(value)
    end

    seen = seen or {}
    if seen[value] then
        return "<recursive-table>"
    end
    seen[value] = true

    local sanitized = {}
    for k, v in pairs(value) do
        local sanitizedKey = sanitizeForJson(k, seen)
        if type(sanitizedKey) ~= "string" and type(sanitizedKey) ~= "number" then
            sanitizedKey = tostring(sanitizedKey)
        end
        sanitized[sanitizedKey] = sanitizeForJson(v, seen)
    end

    seen[value] = nil
    return sanitized
end

local function collectErsDiagnostics()
    local plugin = type(Config.plugins) == "table" and Config.plugins.ersintegration or nil
    local fallback = {
        enabled = type(plugin) == "table" and plugin.enabled == true,
        ready = false,
        nightErsState = GetResourceState("night_ers"),
        status = "ERS diagnostics provider did not load; verify the ERS server submodule is installed and check startup errors"
    }
    if type(plugin) == "table" and plugin.enabled == false then
        fallback.status = plugin.disableReason or "disabled in config"
    end
    if type(GetErsIntegrationDiagnostics) == "function" then
        local ok, result = pcall(GetErsIntegrationDiagnostics)
        if ok and type(result) == "table" then
            return sanitizeForJson(result)
        end
        fallback.lastFailure = {
            stage = "diagnostics",
            reason = ok and "ERS diagnostics returned invalid data" or tostring(result):sub(1, 300)
        }
    end
    return fallback
end

 function dumpInfo()
    local version = GetResourceMetadata(GetCurrentResourceName(), "version", 0)
    local pluginList, loadedPlugins, disabledPlugins = GetPluginLists()
    local pluginVersions = {}
    local cadVariables = { ["netPort"] = GetConvar("netPort", "Unknown")}
    local variableList = ""
    for k, v in pairs(cadVariables) do
        variableList = ("%s%s = %s\n"):format(variableList, k, v)
    end
    for k, v in pairs(pluginList) do
        if Config.plugins[v] then
            table.insert(pluginVersions, ("%s [%s/%s]"):format(v, Config.plugins[v].version, Config.plugins[v].latestVersion))
        end
    end
    local coreConfig = {}
    for k, v in pairs(Config) do
        if (k == "plugins") then goto continue end
        if type(v) == "function" then goto continue end
        if type(v) == "table" then
            local encoded = SafeJsonEncode(sanitizeForJson(v), ("support dump core config %s"):format(tostring(k)), "{}")
            table.insert(coreConfig, ("%s = %s"):format(k, encoded or "{}"))
            goto continue
        end
        if type(v) == "thread" then goto continue end
        table.insert(coreConfig, ("%s = %s"):format(k, v))
        coreConfig[k] = v
        ::continue::
    end
    return ([[
SonoranCAD
Version: %s - Latest: %s
FXS Version: %s
Available Submodules
%s
Loaded Submodules
%s
Disabled Submodules
%s
Relevant Variables
%s
Core Configuration
%s
    ]]):format(version, Config.latestVersion, getServerVersion(), table.concat(pluginVersions, ", "), table.concat(loadedPlugins, ", "), table.concat(disabledPlugins, ", "), variableList, table.concat(coreConfig, "\n"))
end

local function collectNetworkDiagnostics()
    local complete = false
    local statusCode = nil
    local responseBody = nil
    PerformHttpRequest('https://api.ipify.org?format=json', function(code, body)
        statusCode = tonumber(code)
        responseBody = body
        complete = true
    end, 'GET', '', { ['Accept'] = 'application/json', ['X-User-Agent'] = 'SonoranCAD' })

    local startedAt = GetGameTimer()
    while not complete and (GetGameTimer() - startedAt) < 10000 do
        Wait(50)
    end

    local detectedIp = '<unavailable>'
    local lookupStatus = complete and ('HTTP %s'):format(tostring(statusCode or 'unknown')) or 'timed out'
    if complete and statusCode == 200 then
        local decoded = SafeJsonDecode(responseBody, 'support outbound IP lookup', nil)
        if type(decoded) == 'table' and type(decoded.ip) == 'string' and decoded.ip ~= '' then
            detectedIp = decoded.ip
            lookupStatus = 'success'
        else
            lookupStatus = 'invalid response'
        end
    end

    local serverInfo = type(ServerInfo) == 'table' and ServerInfo or {}
    return ([[
Fresh outbound IP = %s
Lookup status = %s
Configured map IP = %s
Configured listener port = %s
Differing outbound enabled = %s
Configured outbound IP = %s
    ]]):format(
        detectedIp,
        lookupStatus,
        tostring(serverInfo.mapIp or '<unavailable>'),
        tostring(serverInfo.listenerPort or GetConvar('netPort', '<unavailable>')),
        tostring(serverInfo.differingOutbound == true),
        tostring(serverInfo.outboundIp or ''))
end

function dumpPlugin(name)
    local pluginDetail = {}
    if not Config.plugins[name] then
        print("Bad plugin: "..name)
        return nil
    end
    for k, v in pairs(Config.plugins[name]) do
        table.insert(pluginDetail, ("%s = %s"):format(k, v))
    end
    return ([[
Plugin: %s
Version: %s
Configuration:
    %s
    ]]):format(name, Config.plugins[name].version, table.concat(pluginDetail, "\n     "))
end

local function sendSupportLogs(key, requester)
    requester = tonumber(requester) or 0
    infoLog("Please wait, gathering required data...")
    local cadOutput = {}
    cadOutput.key = tonumber(key)
    if cadOutput.key == nil then
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_INVALID_ID")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_INVALID_ID")
        end
        return false
    end
    local networkDiagnostics = collectNetworkDiagnostics()
    local plugins = {}
    for name, config in pairs(Config.plugins) do
        local pluginData = {}
        pluginData.name = name
        pluginData.version = config.version
        pluginData.config = sanitizeForJson(config)
        table.insert(plugins, pluginData)
    end
    cadOutput.plugins = plugins
    cadOutput.errors = sanitizeForJson(getSupportErrorBuffer())
    cadOutput.ersIntegration = collectErsDiagnostics()
    local encodedErrors = "[]"
    if cadOutput.errors ~= nil then
        local ok, serialized = pcall(json.encode, cadOutput.errors)
        if ok and type(serialized) == "string" then
            encodedErrors = serialized
        end
    end
    cadOutput.logs = ([[
SonoranCAD Support Output
---------------------------------------
Configuration Information
---
%s

---------------------------------------
Network Diagnostics
-------------------
%s

---------------------------------------
Structured Error Buffer
-----------------------
%s
---------------------------------------
ERS Integration Health
----------------------
%s
---------------------------------------
Console Buffer
------
%s
---------------------------------------
Last 50 Debug Messages
----------------------
%s
    ]]):format(dumpInfo(), networkDiagnostics, encodedErrors,
        SafeJsonEncode(cadOutput.ersIntegration, "support ERS diagnostics", "{}"),
        GetConsoleBuffer(), table.concat(getDebugBuffer(), "\n"))
    Config.debugMode = false
    if SetCadClientLogLevel ~= nil then
        SetCadClientLogLevel()
    end
    local response = CadApiUploadSupportLogs(sanitizeForJson(cadOutput))
    local uploadSucceeded = response.success == true
    if uploadSucceeded then
        infoLog("Support logs have been successfully uploaded. Debug mode was disabled during the upload.")
        if requester > 0 then
            NotifyPlayer(requester, {
                title = "Support",
                message = formatErrorMessage("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_SUCCESS"),
                type = "success"
            })
        end
        return true
    elseif response.success then
        local message = ("%s Response: %s"):format(getErrorText("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED"), tostring(type(response.data) == "table" and (response.data.error or SafeJsonEncode(response.data, "support upload partial success", "{}")) or response.data))
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED", message)
        end
    else
        local message = ("%s Reason: %s"):format(getErrorText("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED"), CadApiReasonText(response.reason))
        if requester > 0 then
            sendClientError(requester, "SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED")
        else
            logError("SUPPORT_UPLOAD_FAILED", message)
        end
    end
    return false
end

local function handlePlayerSonoranCommand(source, args)
    local action = args[1] and string.lower(args[1]) or "help"

    if action == "help" then
        TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandHelp", source, args[2])
        return
    end

    if action == "support" then
        if args[2] == nil or args[2] == "" then
            TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage", source, "Usage: /sonorancad support <id>")
            return
        end
        sendSupportLogs(args[2], source)
        return
    end

    TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:ShowCommandMessage", source,
        ("Unknown or console-only action '%s'. Use /sonorancad help."):format(tostring(action)))
end

RegisterCommand("sonorancad", function(source, args, rawCommand)
    if source ~= 0 then
        handlePlayerSonoranCommand(source, args or {})
        return
    end
    if not args[1] then
        print("Missing command. Try \"sonorancad help\" for help.")
        return
    end
    if args[1] == "help" then
        print([[
SonoranCAD Help
    debugmode - Toggles debugging mode
    info - dump version info, configuration
    support - dump useful data for support staff
    errors - display all error/warning messages since last startup
    plugin <name> - show info about a plugin (config)
    ers - show ERS integration health and last failure
    update - Run core updater
    migrate - Upload legacy resource/plugin settings to CAD (console only)
    viewcaches - View the current unit and call cache, for troubleshooting
    getclientlog <playerId> - Get a log buffer from a given client
    dumpconsole - Dumps current console buffer to file
]])
    elseif args[1] == "migrate" then
        MigrateCadConfiguration()
    elseif args[1] == "debugmode" then
        Config.debugMode = not Config.debugMode
        local convarString = ""
        if Config.debugMode then
            convarString = "true"
        else
            convarString = "false"
        end
        SetConvar("sonoran_debugMode", convarString)
        if SetCadClientLogLevel ~= nil then
            SetCadClientLogLevel()
        end
        infoLog(("Debug mode toggled to %s"):format(convarString))
        TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:debugModeToggle", -1, Config.debugMode)
        local sonoran = sonoranModule or load_sonoran_module()
        GetCadClient():setLogLevel(get_sonoran_log_level(sonoran))
    elseif args[1] == "quietprint" then
        local enabled = GetConvar("sonoran_quietPrint", "false") == "true"
        local convarString = enabled and "false" or "true"
        SetConvar("sonoran_quietPrint", convarString)
        print(("SonoranCAD quietPrint toggled to %s"):format(convarString))
    elseif args[1] == "info" then
        print(dumpInfo())
    elseif args[1] == "ers" then
        print(SafeJsonEncode(collectErsDiagnostics(), "ERS diagnostics", "{}"))
    elseif args[1] == "support" and args[2] ~= nil then
        sendSupportLogs(args[2], 0)
    elseif args[1] == "plugin" and args[2] then
        if Config.plugins[args[2]] then
            print(dumpPlugin(args[2]))
        else
            errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid plugin.")
        end
    elseif args[1] == "update" then --update - attempt to auto-update
        infoLog("Checking for core update...")
        RunAutoUpdater(true)
    elseif args[1] == "dumpconsole" then
        local savePath = GetResourcePath(GetCurrentResourceName()).."/buffer.log"
        local f, openErr = io.open(savePath, 'wb')
        if not f then
            logError("FILE_WRITE_FAILED", ("Failed to open console dump path %s: %s"):format(savePath, tostring(openErr)))
            return
        end
        local ok, writeErr = pcall(function()
            f:write(GetConsoleBuffer())
            f:close()
        end)
        if not ok then
            logError("FILE_WRITE_FAILED", ("Failed to write console dump path %s: %s"):format(savePath, tostring(writeErr)))
            return
        end
        infoLog("Wrote buffer to "..savePath)
    elseif args[1] == "pluginupdate" then
        infoLog("Scanning for plugin updates...")
        for k, v in pairs(Config.plugins) do
            CheckForPluginUpdate(k, true)
        end
    elseif args[1] == "viewcaches" then
        local units = GetUnitCache()
        local calls = GetCallCache()
        print(("Units: %s\r\nCalls: %s"):format(json.encode(units), json.encode(calls)))
        print("Done")
    elseif args[1] == "getclientlog" then
        if args[2] then
            if GetPlayerName(args[2]) ~= nil then
                TriggerClientEvent("SonoranCAD::core:RequestLogBuffer", args[2])
                infoLog("Requested log buffer. Please wait...")
            else
                errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid player ID.")
            end
        else
            errorLog("INVALID_COMMAND_ARGUMENT", "Invalid argument.")
        end
    elseif args[1] == "errors" then
        print("----ERROR/WARNING BUFFER START----")
        local buf = getErrorBuffer()
        for i=1, #buf do
            print(buf[i])
        end
        print("----ERROR/WARNING BUFFER END----")
    else
        print("Missing command. Try \"sonorancad help\" for help.")
    end
end, false)

function GetPluginLists()
    local pluginList = {}
    local loadedPlugins = {}
    local disabledPlugins = {}
    local disableFormatted = {}
    for name, v in pairs(Config.plugins) do
        table.insert(pluginList, name)
        if v.enabled then
            table.insert(loadedPlugins, name)
        else
            if v.disableReason == nil then
                v.disableReason = "disabled in config"
            end
            disabledPlugins[name] = v.disableReason
        end
    end
    for name, reason in pairs(disabledPlugins) do
        table.insert(disableFormatted, ("%s (%s)"):format(name, reason))
    end
    return pluginList, loadedPlugins, disableFormatted
end

-- Support Push Event

AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::pushevents:SendSupportLogs", function(key)
    infoLog("Support has requested logs to be uploaded. Collecting now...")
    sendSupportLogs(key, 0)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("SonoranCAD::core:UploadSupportLogs")
AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::core:UploadSupportLogs", function(key)
    sendSupportLogs(key, source)
end)

RegisterNetEvent("SonoranCAD::core:LogBuffer")
AddEventHandler("SonoranCAD::core:LogBuffer", function(buffer)
    infoLog(("Incoming log buffer from player %s"):format(source))
    for i=1, #buffer do
        print((": %s"):format(buffer[i]))
    end
    infoLog("End of buffer")
end)

Config = {
    communityID = nil,
    apiKey = nil,
    apiUrl = nil,
    postTime = nil,
    serverId = nil,
    freezeUntilLinked = false,
    primaryIdentifier = nil,
    apiSendEnabled = nil,
    debugMode = nil,
    notificationSystem = "auto",
    updateBranch = nil,
    enableCanary = false,
    latestVersion = '',
    apiVersion = -1,
    plugins = {}
}
for key, value in pairs(CadLinkDefaults) do Config[key] = value end


-- The only customer-facing local settings are API key and server ID. Legacy
-- credentials are read only until an existing installation has migrated.
local resource = GetCurrentResourceName()
local function decode(raw)
    local ok, value = pcall(json.decode, raw or '')
    if ok and type(value) == 'table' then return value end
end
local rootRaw = LoadResourceFile(resource, 'config.json')
local rootEmpty = rootRaw == nil or rootRaw:match('^%s*$') ~= nil
local bootstrap = not rootEmpty and decode(rootRaw) or nil
local bootstrapError
if not rootEmpty then
    if not bootstrap or not rootRaw:match('^%s*{') then bootstrapError = 'config.json must contain a valid JSON object.'
    else
        for key in pairs(bootstrap) do
            if key ~= 'apiKey' and key ~= 'serverId' then bootstrapError = 'config.json may contain only apiKey and serverId.' end
        end
    end
end
if not bootstrapError and (not bootstrap or bootstrap.apiKey == nil or bootstrap.apiKey == '') then
    local legacy = decode(LoadResourceFile(resource, 'configuration/config.json')) or
        decode(LoadResourceFile(resource, 'configuration_old/config.json'))
    if legacy then bootstrap = {apiKey = legacy.apiKey, serverId = tonumber(legacy.serverId)} end
end
bootstrap = bootstrap or {}
if type(bootstrap.apiKey) ~= 'string' or bootstrap.apiKey == '' or type(bootstrap.serverId) ~= 'number' or
    bootstrap.serverId < 1 or bootstrap.serverId % 1 ~= 0 then
    bootstrapError = bootstrapError or 'Set apiKey and a positive numeric serverId in the resource-root config.json.'
end
Config.apiKey, Config.serverId = bootstrap.apiKey, bootstrap.serverId
Config.bootstrapError = bootstrapError
if not bootstrapError then
    SetConvar('sonoran_apiKey', Config.apiKey)
    SetConvar('sonoran_serverId', tostring(Config.serverId))
end
Config.configurationReady = false
Plugins = {}
updaterIgnore = {ignore = {}}
local activeDocument
local cacheable = false
local mock = GetConvar('sonoran_configurationMock', 'false') == 'true'
local cacheScope = exports[resource]:GetCadConfigurationScope(Config.apiKey, Config.serverId, GetCadConfigurationBootstrapUrl(), mock)
Config.configurationScope = cacheScope
local cachePath = '.configuration-cache.json'

local function warn(message) warnLog('UNHANDLED_WARNING', '[configuration] ' .. message) end
local function fail(message) errorLog('CONFIG_ERROR', '[configuration] ' .. message) end
local function disabled(reason) return {enabled = false, disableReason = reason} end

local coreTypes = {
    postTime='number', primaryIdentifier='string', apiSendEnabled='boolean', debugMode='boolean',
    notificationSystem='string', updateBranch='string', enableCanary='boolean',
    statusLabels='table', allowAutoUpdate='boolean', autoUpdateUrl='string', allowUpdateWithPlayers='boolean',
    noUnitTimer='boolean', enablePushEventForwarding='boolean', pushEventForwardUrl='string',
    disableOverride='boolean', devHiddenSwitch='boolean', communityID='string', mode='string'
}
local legacyCoreTypes = {freezeUntilLinked = 'boolean'}
for key, expected in pairs(coreTypes) do legacyCoreTypes[key] = expected end
for key, value in pairs(CadLinkDefaults) do legacyCoreTypes[key] = type(value) end
local function validate(document, phase)
    local migrating = phase == 'migration'
    local allowPartial = migrating or phase == 'legacy'
    if type(document) ~= 'table' or type(document.core) ~= 'table' or type(document.plugins) ~= 'table' then
        return nil, 'Expected a complete core/plugins configuration document.'
    end
    if not migrating and (type(document.core.communityID) ~= 'string' or document.core.communityID == '') then
        return nil, 'CAD response is missing a valid core.communityID.'
    end
    if not migrating and document.core.mode ~= 'production' and document.core.mode ~= 'development' then
        return nil, 'CAD response must include core.mode set to production or development.'
    end
    -- These required core values cannot come from old files or convar overrides.
    if not migrating and (type(document.core.primaryIdentifier) ~= 'string' or document.core.primaryIdentifier == '' or
        type(document.core.postTime) ~= 'number' or document.core.postTime <= 0 or
        type(document.core.apiSendEnabled) ~= 'boolean') then
        return nil, 'Missing or invalid primaryIdentifier, postTime or apiSendEnabled.'
    end
    for key, value in pairs(document.core) do
        if legacyCoreTypes[key] == nil or type(value) ~= legacyCoreTypes[key] then
            return nil, 'Unsupported or invalid core setting: ' .. tostring(key)
        end
    end
    if type(document.updaterIgnore) ~= 'table' or type(document.updaterIgnore.ignore) ~= 'table' or
        type(document.vehicleModels) ~= 'table' or type(document.callTemplates) ~= 'table' then
        return nil, 'Missing updaterIgnore, vehicleModels or callTemplates configuration.'
    end
    NormalizeCadLinkConfiguration(document)
    local parsed, errors = {}, {}
    for name, value in pairs(document.plugins) do
        if type(name) ~= 'string' or not name:match('^[%w_-]+$') then return nil, 'Invalid plugin name.' end
        local settings, err = ParseCadPluginConfiguration(name, value, allowPartial)
        if not settings then errors[#errors + 1] = err end
        parsed[name] = settings or disabled(err)
    end
    local templates = parsed.calltemplates
    if templates and templates.enabled then
        for _, command in pairs(templates.commands or {}) do
            if type(command) ~= 'table' or type(command.callTypeFile) ~= 'string' or
                type(document.callTemplates[command.callTypeFile]) ~= 'table' then
                local message = 'Missing or invalid call template in CAD configuration.'
                errors[#errors + 1] = message
                parsed.calltemplates = disabled(message)
                break
            end
        end
    end
    return parsed, #errors > 0 and table.concat(errors, '; ') or nil
end

Config.GetPluginConfig = function(name)
    while not Config.configurationReady or (Config.apiVersion == -1 and not Config.critError) do Wait(25) end
    if Config.critError then return disabled('Configuration startup aborted') end
    return Config.plugins[name] or disabled('Missing CAD configuration; configure this plugin in CAD')
end
Config.LoadPlugin = function(name, callback)
    local settings = Config.GetPluginConfig(name)
    if settings.enabled ~= true then return end
    return callback(settings)
end
-- Old config scripts must never register over authoritative settings.
Config.RegisterPluginConfig = function() warn('Local plugin configuration registration ignored. Manage settings in CAD.') end
exports('GetPluginConfig', function(name) return Config.GetPluginConfig(name) end)
exports('GetResolvedConfig', function()
    return json.encode({ready = Config.configurationReady and not Config.critError,
        communityID = Config.communityID, serverId = Config.serverId,
